title: Business Analyst – Mosambi
description:
**About Us: Climate Collective Foundation (CCF)**

 Climate Collective Foundation is a not\-for\-profit organization dedicated to supporting climate tech startups. We work within the climate ecosystem to foster innovation by connecting startups with funding, investors, education, and accelerator programs. Our team of 65 members operates collaboratively to drive impactful, sustainable solutions for climate\-related challenges.
 



  





**Role Summary** 





 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented
 
**Business Analyst** 

 to support the growth of the Mosambi platform by assisting with partner outreach, stakeholder engagement, business coordination, and documentation. The role involves working closely with the leadership team to identify prospective partners, coordinate meetings, prepare business materials, manage CRM records, and ensure timely follow\-up on ongoing discussions.
 




  






 In addition to supporting external partnerships, the role will play a key part in strengthening Mosambi's internal business functions by assisting with strategic documentation, business research, partnership proposals, investor presentations, fundraising materials, product roadmap inputs, and other business planning initiatives. The Business Analyst will work closely with cross\-functional teams to gather information, develop high\-quality documentation, conduct market and ecosystem research, and support leadership in driving strategic business initiatives.
 




  






 The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with senior management across startups, corporates, government organizations, investors, and ecosystem partners. This role provides exposure to business development, strategic planning, ecosystem building, fundraising, and partnership development within the climate technology ecosystem.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Partnership Development \& Stakeholder Engagement:** 

 Identify, engage, and build relationships with startups, investors, corporates, ecosystem organizations, government agencies, service providers, and other strategic partners. Conduct outreach activities, schedule introductory discussions, and support the onboarding of partners across Mosambi platform.
 




  





**Business Strategy Support:** 

 Support the leadership team in developing internal strategic business documents that drive the growth of the Mosambi platform. Assist in preparing vision documents, product roadmaps, fundraising materials, partnership proposals, investor presentations, and business plans by conducting research, gathering inputs from internal teams, organizing information, and ensuring documentation is accurate, well\-structured, and presentation ready.
 




  





**Business Coordination \& Relationship Management:** 

 Act as the primary point of coordination between internal teams and external stakeholders by organizing meetings, preparing agendas, creating required documentation, documenting discussions, and ensuring timely follow\-ups. Maintain strong relationships with partners while ensuring smooth communication throughout the engagement lifecycle.
 




  





**Documentation \& Proposal Management:** 

 Prepare partner\-facing materials like presentations, proposals, partnership documents, meeting notes, reports, and other business documentation required for stakeholder engagement. Ensure that all documents are accurate, professionally presented, and readily available for internal and external discussions. 
 




  





**Project \& CRM Management:** 

 Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, business opportunities, meeting outcomes, and follow\-up activities within the CRM system. Track partnership pipelines, monitor progress, manage project timelines, and ensure action items are completed within agreed timelines.
 




  





**Market Research \& Business Analysis:** 

 Conduct market research to identify potential partners, emerging opportunities, and ecosystem trends. Develop target lists, collect business intelligence, and provide insights that support partnership strategy and platform growth.
 




  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 

 Work closely with leadership, product, operations, research, and engineering teams to understand platform offerings and effectively communicate Mosambi's value proposition. Coordinate internally to ensure partnership commitments are executed successfully.
 




  





**Reporting \& Process Improvement:** 

 Prepare regular reports on outreach activities, partnership progress, onboarding status, and business development metrics. Continuously recommend improvements to business development processes, CRM management, and stakeholder engagement workflows.
 




  





**Required Qualification** 



* 2–5 years of experience in Business Development, Partnerships, Business Analysis, Account Management, or Project Coordination.
* Experience interacting with senior management and external stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently and stakeholder engagements.



  





  





**Technical Skills** 




  






 The ideal candidate should be comfortable using modern business productivity and project management tools.
 



* **CRM \& Business Tools:** 

 Salesforce CRM; Zoho CRM (or equivalent CRM platforms).
* **Project Management:** 

 Jira; Basecamp.
* **Documentation \& Productivity:** 

 Microsoft Word; Microsoft Excel; Microsoft PowerPoint; Claude; Google Docs; Google Sheets; Canva.

title: Computer Science Faculty Intern
description:
**Job Description: Computer Science Faculty Intern**

**Location:** Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh **Work Mode:** On\-site **Job Type:** Full\-time Internship **Duration:** 6 Months **Experience:** 0–2 Years **Stipend:** ₹5,000 – ₹12,000 per month, based on performance **Department:** Academics / Training

**About HI Labs**

HI Labs is building serious, outcome\-focused technology education programs for students who want to become industry\-ready software engineers.

Our programs focus on **strong computer science fundamentals, practical software development, AI\-native engineering practices, real\-world projects, discipline, and internship readiness.**

We believe students should not just learn how to write code. They should understand **how and why software works**, develop strong problem\-solving skills, and learn how to approach problems like engineers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Software Mentor/Faculty Trainee** who is passionate about software development, enjoys helping others learn, and wants to develop strong skills in both **software engineering and technical mentoring**.

As a Software Mentor Trainee, you will work with students and the academic team to help learners understand programming, computer science fundamentals, software development concepts, assignments, and projects.

This is **not a traditional coding trainer role**. You will be expected to understand concepts deeply and gradually learn how to explain them clearly, guide students through problems, review their work, and connect theoretical concepts with practical software development.

This role is particularly suitable for **fresh graduates, recent graduates, developers with 0–2 years of experience, and candidates with strong technical fundamentals who are interested in teaching or mentoring.**

**Key Areas You May Work With**

Depending on your skills and program requirements, you may work on the following areas:

**Programming \& Problem Solving**

* Programming fundamentals
* Logic building
* Problem\-solving techniques
* Code reading and debugging
* Basic algorithmic thinking
* Programming exercises

**Computer Science Fundamentals**

* Data Structures \& Algorithms
* Database Management Systems
* SQL fundamentals
* PostgreSQL basics
* Operating Systems fundamentals
* Computer Networks basics
* Software Engineering principles

**Software Development**

* JavaScript / TypeScript fundamentals
* Backend development basics
* APIs and request\-response concepts
* Node.js / Express.js
* MERN stack fundamentals
* Git and GitHub
* Clean code and project structure
* Real\-world software development workflows

**AI\-Native Development**

* Responsible use of AI tools in software development
* AI\-assisted debugging
* Using AI for development workflows
* Effective prompting for coding tasks
* Understanding when AI can be used and when strong fundamentals are required

**Key Responsibilities**

As a Software Mentor Trainee, you will:

* Assist in conducting technical learning sessions for students.
* Explain programming and computer science concepts using simple examples.
* Conduct doubt\-clearing sessions under the guidance of the academic team.
* Help students with assignments, exercises, and programming problems.
* Review student code and provide constructive feedback.
* Help students identify and fix errors in their code.
* Guide students through small software development projects.
* Assist students in understanding programming concepts and development workflows.
* Prepare basic exercises, assignments, and revision materials.
* Track student progress and identify areas where additional support is required.
* Maintain session notes and basic learning documentation.
* Collaborate with the academic team to improve learning materials.
* Gradually take ownership of selected topics or modules based on your performance and technical ability.
* Encourage students to develop strong fundamentals, problem\-solving ability, discipline, and an engineering mindset.

**Educational QualificationsPreferred Qualifications**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* M.Tech / M.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* MCA

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also be considered if they demonstrate **strong programming fundamentals and genuine interest in software development and mentoring.**

**Experience**

**Experience Required: 0–2 Years**

We welcome:

* Freshers and recent graduates
* Candidates with 0–2 years of software development experience
* Candidates with internship experience
* Candidates with teaching, tutoring, or mentoring experience
* Candidates who have helped peers or juniors learn technical concepts
* Candidates with strong academic or personal software projects

title: Scientific Computing Engineer - Drug Product Process Modeling & Data Science
description:
**Summary**
* Understands business problems, supports an integrated analytical approach to mine data sources, manage data effectively, employ statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to contribute to solving unmet medical needs, discover actionable insights, and automate processes for reducing effort and time for repeated use.
* Provide data science and quantitative analytical support by ensuring the timely delivery of high\-quality reports.
* Build capabilities to leverage the Science of data.


**About The Role**
**Major Accountabilities**
* Develop and apply mechanistic, empirical, statistical, and hybrid modeling approaches to support drug product formulation and process development, especially for process understanding, scale\-up, and manufacturing\-relevant questions.
* Translate formulation and process questions into model\- and data\-ready problem statements; define success criteria, assumptions, and uncertainty considerations with subject\-matter experts.
* Apply statistics, Design of Experiments, multivariate analysis, and data\-driven modeling to plan experiments, analyze results, and accelerate learning cycles.
* Build predictive models and decision\-support tools for key drug product unit operations, with particular interest in oral solid dosage forms, powder technology, formulation, and process engineering.
* Build end\-to\-end data science solutions including data preparation, exploratory analysis, modeling, validation, deployment, and lifecycle management, with a focus on transparency and reproducibility.
* Create clear visualizations, dashboards, and technical narratives to communicate insights and support decision making for diverse stakeholders.
* Contribute to automation and AI\-assisted workflows for data preparation, modeling, analysis, and reporting, while maintaining scientific oversight and practical usability.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, internal standards, and reusable modeling/AI assets within the global modeling and digital community.


**Essential Skills**
* Master’s degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, process engineering, chemical engineering, pharmaceutical engineering, materials science, applied mathematics, statistics, data science, or a closely related quantitative engineering discipline.
* Early\-career profile preferred, typically with 2–4 years of relevant industry experience after a master’s degree or 0–4 years after a PhD, and a clear motivation for hands\-on modeling, coding, and applied problem solving.
* Core skills
* Strong engineering and mathematical foundation, including process science, transport phenomena, statistics, numerical methods, and/or mechanistic modeling.
* Must have hands\-on programming experience in Python or a similar programming language, with the ability and motivation to become productive in Python very quickly if not already fluent.
* Experience applying statistics, DoE, data analysis, simulation, optimization, and/or machine learning to engineering or scientific problems.
* Ability to work with experimental and industrial datasets, including data cleaning, exploratory analysis, and uncertainty\-aware interpretation including model credibility assessments according to regulatory guidelines \& standards.
* Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to non\-experts and influence decisions.
* Digital \& AI capabilities (beneficial; can be developed on the job)
* Basic experience with machine learning, model evaluation, or AI\-enabled analytics is an advantage, but less important than strong engineering fundamentals, coding ability, and learning agility.
* Interest in AI\-assisted modeling, automation, and agent\-based workflows, with willingness to learn and apply these methods in a scientifically rigorous way.
* Understanding of model lifecycle management, reproducibility, and deployment considerations in regulated environments.
* Experience with visualization and storytelling, such as dashboards or clear technical reporting.


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience or academic exposure to powder technology, formulation science, oral solid dosage forms, pharmaceutical unit operations, process modeling tools, PBM, DEM, gPROMS, or digital twins.
* Exposure to QbD principles, PAT concepts, or regulatory\-relevant modeling activities.
* Experience working in global matrix organizations.

title: System Software Engineer - Performance Verification Infrastructure
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2025205
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 Join NVIDIA's GPU Performance Infrastructure team and be part of a brand\-new journey in validating and shipping next\-generation GPU architectures. At NVIDIA, we empower our engineers to innovate and drive powerful performance through innovative infrastructure and workflows. This role is uniquely positioned to influence the entire lifecycle of GPU performance verification, from early\-stage modelling to post\-silicon validation. With our bold standards and extraordinary team, you'll have the chance to define a significant impact on the future of computing!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design and maintain automated chip performance verification pipelines spanning workload trace generation, multi\-target test execution, results post\-processing, and correlation with architectural performance targets.
* Develop performance monitoring and measurement infrastructure that provides consistent observability across simulation, emulation, and silicon environments.
* Build scalable data pipelines and full\-stack dashboards to ingest, visualize, and compare performance metrics across builds and environments.
* Coordinate with GPU architects to craft infrastructure for performance verification of upcoming architectures.
* Work closely with HW teams to automate and accelerate verification workflows, enabling faster GPU build iteration.
* Empower GPU architects by providing insights to understand current performance and model industry\-leading performance for future builds.
* Improve the daily workflows of the world's top chip architects, contributing to the creation of the next greatest generation of GPUs!


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in C\+\+, with Python for tooling and automation.
* Strong CS fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, OOP, and system design.
* Full\-stack experience with backend (Java/Python), REST APIs, and modern frontend (React/Ember) for data\-intensive applications is a plus.
* Proficiency in databases (SQL, MongoDB) for metrics storage and querying is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Git, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and messaging systems (RabbitMQ) is a plus.
* Exposure to GPU/CPU/SoC chip performance verification is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI development tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

**ABOUT INTERBIND TECHNOLOGIES**

Interbind Technologies is a Coimbatore\-based product engineering company building commercial, cloud\-based software for a global customer base. Our engineering culture is hands\-on and collaborative: we value clean code, sound design, and engineers who take ownership of what they build. Joining us means working on real products, learning modern technologies, and growing alongside a close\-knit technical team.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a Software Engineer to design and develop commercial software products as part of our core engineering team. You will build web and cloud\-based applications end to end — from translating requirements into technical designs, to writing robust server\-side and integration code, to shipping features that customers rely on. This is a growth role for an engineer who is passionate about programming and eager to work across the full stack.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Work with the technical lead and product management to translate high\-level requirements into technical designs and production\-ready code.
* Understand the product architecture and develop core framework and middleware components.
* Design and build proof\-of\-concepts to validate new ideas and technical approaches.
* Collaborate with a team of engineers across web, server\-side, and integration technologies.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integration flows connecting internal and external systems.
* Write clean, well\-tested code and contribute to unit and integration testing.
* Recommend and champion tools and best practices that improve software quality and delivery.
* Continuously learn new technologies and bring innovative, practical solutions to the team.

**REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

* **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience designing and building Java / J2EE applications with a JavaScript front\-end framework.
* Strong command of **Java, J2EE, REST and web services, application security, and open\-source frameworks including Spring, Spring Boot, and Hibernate / JPA**.
* Experience building and integrating systems using enterprise integration frameworks such as Apache Camel (or a strong willingness to learn).
* Proficiency with SQL and relational databases — MS SQL Server, MySQL, or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of front\-end technologies: HTML, CSS, and a modern JS framework such as React, Angular, or Node.js.
* Strong analytical thinking and debugging skills — a natural technical trouble shooter.
* Ability to translate product designs into clean, maintainable code, backed by unit tests.
* Solid understanding of the full product development life cycle and Agile methodologies (Scrum or XP).
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with short delivery timelines.
* Basic command\-line experience with Linux.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Exposure to cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with Struts or other legacy frameworks during modernization projects.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containers (Docker), or microservices architecture.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary matched to your experience and skills.
* Hands\-on work on commercial, cloud\-based products used by real customers.
* A collaborative, learning\-focused engineering culture with room to grow.
* Exposure to a modern technology stack and mentorship from senior engineers.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your updated resume to **careers@interbind.in** , **kamali.j@interbind.in, Contact Number : 95978 55544** with the subject line “Software Engineer – Java / Spring Boot”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a technical discussion.

title: Junior/Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**About The Role**
**REMOTE IN INDIA**
 We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest\-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin\-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency. The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self\-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event\-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin\-packing, right\-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.
   

  

 A product mindset \- you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.
 **You build it, you own it.** 
 You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring\-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
* Build the self\-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
* Automate self\-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
* Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.
* Partner with the inference/ML platform team: understand the cluster shapes they need — topology, interconnect, scheduling constraints — and encode them as first\-class abstractions in the platform.
* Engineer it like software: strong typing, automated tests, code review, versioning, and CI/CD for infrastructure code — this is a product, not a collection of Ansible playbooks.


**Requirements**
 Core requirements (all levels):
   

  

* Strong software engineering background in Go, Python, Rust, or similar — you write and test real software for a living.
* Experience with durable workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal, Cadence, or equivalent to run long\-lived, manifest\-driven workflows that survive failures and resume mid\-execution.
* Experience building software control planes or orchestration systems that model state and reconcile it over time (e.g., Kubernetes controllers/operators, custom reconciliation loops, workflow engines).
* Experience with event\-driven systems — designing and building software around message queues, event streams, or pub/sub (e.g., Kafka, NATS, SQS) rather than polling or cron\-driven scripts.
* A product mindset. You’ve built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.


**Nice To Have**
* Exposure to bare\-metal provisioning (PXE/iPXE, Redfish/IPMI, BMC) and/or networking fundamentals (VLANs, BGP, fabric design), or GPU/accelerator infrastructure.
* Experience with GPU cluster software stacks (NCCL, CUDA, InfiniBand/RoCE).
* Prior work at a hyperscaler, GPU cloud, or datacenter\-scale infrastructure organization.
* Systems programming in Rust or Go.


**About Together AI**
 Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

description:
**Onsite\- Job location\- Kurla, Mumbai** 




  





 Be the internal owner of detection, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence — the connective tissue between our tooling (Qualys, Palo Alto SIEM/XDR, Cloud SEK) and our outsourced MDR partner. You'll make sure alerts and findings actually get triaged and acted on, and you'll be the coordination point for red team and purple team exercises that test whether our detection stack really works.
 



  





**What you'll own:** 




 • Qualys (vulnerability management) — scan scheduling, triage, severity scoring, remediation SLA tracking
 



 • Palo Alto SIEM/XDR — internal liaison and escalation point for the MDR partner's 24/7 monitoring
 



 • Cloud SEK — triage of external threat intel alerts (leaked credentials, brand impersonation, exposed assets) and routing to the right owners
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




 • Own the MDR partner relationship day\-to\-day: escalation path, alert quality, and detection tuning feedback loop
 



 • Triage Qualys findings, route to engineering owners, and track remediation against SLA — automating ticket creation and routing where possible
 



 • Ensure CloudSEK alerts have a clear owner and don't become unread noise; work with MDR to ingest the feed into their triage queue where feasible
 



 • Coordinate red team / purple team engagements jointly with the MDR partner, once MDR has been live at least one full quarter
 



 • Support pen test remediation verification and technical evidence requests from auditors
 



 • Build and maintain lightweight automation (auto\-ticketing, severity\-based routing, rescan\-verified auto\-close) in line with the team's lean, AI\-driven model
 



 • Flag detection or coverage gaps to the Security Lead, especially where they intersect with regulatory notification timelines
 



  





**What we're looking for:** 




 • 3–6\+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or vulnerability management
 



 • Hands\-on experience with a SIEM/XDR platform (Palo Alto Cortex preferred) and a vulnerability scanner (Qualys preferred)
 



 • Experience working with or managing an MDR/MSSP relationship, including holding a partner accountable to SLAs
 



 • Comfortable owning a triage process end\-to\-end — not just running scans, but making sure findings get fixed
 



 • Familiarity with coordinating external red team, purple team, or pen test engagements

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement*** Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:
* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**

* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage

* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail

* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

  

**Education**:

**Experience**:

**Eligibility Requirements:**

title: Enterprise Solutions & Deal Enablement Associate
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


TartanHQ builds **HyperSync** (a unified API layer connecting HRMS, ERP, and CRM systems) and **HyperVerify** (a unified verification platform for KYC, KYB, income, employment, and contact\-point checks, used by banks, NBFCs, insurers, and lenders).  

We're hiring three **Enterprise Solutions \& Deal Enablement Associates** to sit directly with the solutioning lead, founders and CBO, and become the connective tissue between our enterprise clients and every internal team that has to say "yes" before a deal goes live \- Product, Engineering, InfoSec, Legal, and Finance.  

This is not a pure sales role and not a pure support role. You will:* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.
* Own the internal chase: security questionnaires, MSAs/DPAs, commercial paperwork, technical scoping so deals don't stall waiting on an internal team
* Stay the client's single point of contact through the entire journey, from first solutioning conversation through contracting to go\-live, so they never feel dropped between teams
* Bring an end\-to\-end ownership mindset: if something is blocking a deal or a client, it's your job to notice, chase, and resolve it, not to wait for someone to ask


You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
------------------------------

* **Deal Cycle Turnaround:** Reduce time from first solutioning call to signed contract through proactive internal coordination
* **InfoSec/Vendor Questionnaire Turnaround:** Coordinated response within 3\-7 business days of receipt
* **Contract\-to\-Go\-Live Time:** \< 30 days for standard integrations, tracked jointly with Product/Engineering
* **Client Response Time:** \< 4 hours during business hours for any active deal or account query
* **Internal SLA Adherence:** 90%\+ of InfoSec/Legal/Finance/Product touchpoints closed within agreed internal timelines
* **Active Relationships Managed:** Ability to concurrently manage 8–12 live deals/accounts without dropped threads
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** Positive feedback from both external clients and internal teams (Product, InfoSec, Legal, Finance) on responsiveness and clarity

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Deal Support \& Solutioning (35%)**

* Support the leaders through discovery calls, solution walkthroughs, and RFP/RFI responses for enterprise prospects
* Translate client requirements (HRMS/ERP/CRM integration needs, or KYC/KYB/income/employment verification needs) into a clear internal brief for Product/Engineering
* Prepare first\-cut proposals, solution decks, sample payloads, and commercial summaries to keep deal momentum going
* Track every open opportunity in a shared pipeline/tracker and flag stalled deals before they go cold

### **2\. Cross\-Functional Coordination – InfoSec, Legal, Finance, Product (30%)**

* Own the InfoSec review process for prospects (security questionnaires, ISO 27001/ISO 27701/AICPA/DPDP compliance documentation, VAPT reports) in coordination with the infosec teams, chase, don't wait
* Coordinate MSA, DPA, SOW, and NDA drafting and redlines between the client and TartanHQ's legal counsel, keeping a clear track
* Work with Finance on commercial proposals, pricing confirmations, PO tracking, and invoicing setup for new accounts
* Liaise with Product/Engineering to confirm technical feasibility, connector availability, and realistic go\-live timelines before commitments are made to clients

### **3\. Client Relationship \& Communication (25%)**

* Act as the client's primary point of contact through the deal cycle and into early production, so the relationship survives handoffs between internal teams
* Run a regular communication cadence (calls, status emails, WhatsApp where appropriate) with enterprise stakeholders including BFSI, NBFC, travel, insurance and pension\-sector clients
* Represent client context accurately back to the leaders and internal teams, no information getting lost in translation
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, additional endpoints) during ongoing conversations and flag them to the leaders

### **4\. Documentation, Reporting \& Process (10%)**

* Maintain a single source of truth for every deal's status: commercial, legal, security, and technical via CRM
* Provide the leaders with a clear weekly view of what's moving, what's stuck, and what needs their direct involvement

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------

* 1–3 years in a client\-facing, coordination\-heavy, or B2B support role (sales support, business operations, account management, pre\-sales, or similar) \- strong freshers with excellent communication will be considered
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Hindi fluency a plus for BFSI/enterprise stakeholder conversations)
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, comfortable chasing multiple internal teams without being told to
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable running trackers/spreadsheets across many parallel deals
* Professional, composed, and articulate when dealing with senior enterprise stakeholders
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Basic working understanding of APIs/integrations sufficient to coordinate (not required to write code)
* Proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel; comfort learning CRM/tracker tools quickly

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech, BFSI, or API\-first companies (internships count)
* Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes: security reviews, legal redlines, vendor onboarding
* Exposure to the lending, insurance, travel, or pension ecosystem
* Familiarity with HRIS, accounting / expense tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Greythr, Zoho, Tally, SAP, etc.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Notion, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required

**What We Look For**
--------------------

* **Client\-first mindset:** Genuinely cares whether the client had a good experience, not just whether the task got closed
* **Ownership mentality:** Drives things to completion with minimal supervision; treats "not my job" as not an option
* **Professional \& sincere:** Represents TartanHQ credibly in front of senior stakeholders at large enterprises
* **Coordination discipline:** Can hold 8\-10 moving threads at once without dropping any of them
* **Composure under pressure:** Enterprise deal cycles involve last\-minute asks and shifting timelines, stays steady through it
* **Growth mindset:** This function is being built from scratch; you'll help shape the playbook, not just follow one

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

description:
**Senior Sales Executive / Junior Sales Executive**

Location

**Ernakulam, Kerala**

Department

**Sales \& Marketing**

Segment

**Hospital \& Retail Sales**

Employment Type

**Full\-Time \| Field Sales**

About the Role

Atom Wellness is looking for **dynamic, target\-oriented and customer\-focused Sales Executives** to strengthen our presence in the **Ernakulam region**.

The selected candidate will be responsible for developing business across **hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, medical shops, retailers, distributors and healthcare institutions**.

Candidates with experience in **hospital sales, medical devices, surgical products, orthopaedic products, pharmaceutical sales or healthcare retail sales** will be preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Hospital Sales

* Visit hospitals, clinics, nursing homes and healthcare institutions regularly.
* Develop relationships with **doctors, purchase managers, hospital administrators, biomedical teams, nurses and other key decision\-makers**.
* Promote Atom Wellness products and generate institutional business.
* Identify new hospital accounts and business opportunities.
* Conduct product presentations and demonstrations whenever required.
* Follow up on enquiries, quotations, purchase orders and pending requirements.
* Coordinate with the internal team and distributors for timely product supply.
* Develop long\-term relationships with hospital customers.
* Identify opportunities for surgical, orthopaedic, healthcare and wellness products.

2\. Retail Sales

* Regularly visit **pharmacies, medical shops, surgical stores and healthcare retailers** in the assigned territory.
* Generate regular orders and improve product availability.
* Introduce new products and schemes to retailers.
* Ensure proper product visibility and availability at retail outlets.
* Develop new retail customers and increase market coverage.
* Follow up on pending orders and stock requirements.
* Build strong relationships with retailers and distributors.
* Improve product penetration across the Ernakulam market.

3\. Sales \& Business Development

* Achieve assigned **monthly and quarterly sales targets**.
* Develop new customers and increase business from existing customers.
* Focus on product\-wise and segment\-wise sales growth.
* Generate leads and convert them into regular business.
* Identify new market opportunities within the assigned territory.
* Follow up consistently until order conversion.
* Support new product launches and promotional activities.
* Implement company schemes and marketing campaigns effectively.

4\. Distributor Coordination

* Maintain regular communication with distributors.
* Monitor product availability and stock levels.
* Follow up on pending orders and supplies.
* Coordinate with distributors for market development.
* Support distributor\-to\-retailer business expansion.
* Provide market feedback regarding demand, pricing, competitor activity and customer requirements.

5\. Market Intelligence

* Monitor competitor products, pricing, schemes and market activities.
* Identify emerging healthcare and retail opportunities.
* Collect feedback from hospitals, doctors, retailers and distributors.
* Report market trends and customer requirements to management.
* Identify potential new customers and unexplored areas in Ernakulam.

6\. Reporting \& Work Management

* Maintain daily customer visit reports.
* Update sales and order information regularly.
* Submit daily/weekly/monthly sales reports.
* Maintain customer and prospect information.
* Update activities through the company's designated application/system.
* Prepare territory\-wise visit plans.
* Maintain proper follow\-up records.
* Track orders, collections and outstanding payments.

7\. Collection \& Payment Follow\-up

* Follow up with customers/distributors for outstanding payments.
* Coordinate with the accounts and distribution teams regarding pending collections.
* Ensure timely payment follow\-up without affecting customer relationships.
* Maintain proper records of outstanding amounts.

SENIOR SALES EXECUTIVE – ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

The Senior Sales Executive will additionally be expected to:

* Independently manage the assigned Ernakulam territory.
* Develop and execute territory\-wise sales plans.
* Handle key hospital, retail and distributor accounts.
* Generate and convert high\-value business opportunities.
* Develop new institutional accounts.
* Guide and support junior sales executives when required.
* Analyse sales performance and identify growth opportunities.
* Prepare sales forecasts and territory development plans.
* Take responsibility for achieving assigned territory targets.
* Build strong professional relationships with key healthcare decision\-makers.

JUNIOR SALES EXECUTIVE – RESPONSIBILITIES

The Junior Sales Executive will:

* Conduct regular hospital, pharmacy and retail visits.
* Generate leads and new customer enquiries.
* Promote company products and schemes.
* Generate orders from assigned customers.
* Follow up with existing and prospective customers.
* Assist senior sales personnel in hospital and retail business development.
* Maintain daily visit and sales reports.
* Develop product knowledge through company training.
* Support promotional activities and product launches.
* Gradually develop independent territory\-handling capabilities.

TARGET CUSTOMERS

The candidate will primarily handle:

* Hospitals
* Clinics
* Nursing Homes
* Pharmacies
* Medical Shops
* Surgical Stores
* Orthopaedic Stores
* Healthcare Retailers
* Distributors
* Institutional Customers
* Doctors and Healthcare Professionals
* Purchase Departments
* Hospital Administrators

QUALIFICATION

**Minimum Qualification:**  
Plus Two / Diploma / Any Degree

Candidates with strong field\-sales experience may also be considered.

EXPERIENCEJunior Sales Executive

**0–2 years**

Freshers with good communication skills and a strong interest in healthcare sales may also apply.

Senior Sales Executive

**2–5 years**

Candidates with prior experience in **pharma, medical devices, surgical, orthopaedic, hospital or healthcare retail sales** will be preferred.

REQUIRED SKILLS

* Excellent communication skills
* Good negotiation and convincing ability
* Customer relationship management
* Sales and business development skills
* Territory management
* Product presentation skills
* Strong follow\-up ability
* Target\-oriented approach
* Market development capability
* Basic computer knowledge
* Ability to prepare sales reports
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

The ideal candidate should be:

* Energetic and self\-motivated
* Result\-oriented
* Confident in customer interactions
* Willing to work in the field
* Good at relationship building
* Disciplined in daily reporting
* Strong in follow\-up
* Able to work independently
* Comfortable with sales targets
* Willing to travel within Ernakulam and nearby areas

PERFORMANCE INDICATORS / KPIs

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly sales achievement
* Hospital account development
* New customer additions
* Retailer additions
* Product\-wise sales growth
* Segment\-wise sales achievement
* Number of productive customer visits
* Order conversion
* Collection performance
* Distributor business development
* Market coverage
* New product penetration
* Customer retention
* Daily reporting and activity compliance

* Two\-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.
* Smartphone and basic mobile application knowledge.
* Candidates with existing contacts in hospitals, pharmacies, medical shops, distributors or surgical stores will have an added advantage.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Competitive salary based on experience and capability
* Performance\-based incentives

description:
**We're looking for a** 
****Network Administrator \| EMEA \& APAC Shift****
**This role is** 
**Office Based, Pune Office**
**Network Administrator \- Pune**
 We see this as an exciting opportunity for someone who is proficient at managing all aspects of LAN/WAN network infrastructure including routers, switches, load balancers, and firewalls in both on prem and cloud environments. Reporting to the Associate Director, Network Engineering, this position will work closely with the Site Reliability Operations, Systems Engineering, and Software Development organizations in support of our state\-of\-the\-art 24/7/365 production SaaS service offering. This critical position provides great visibility and individual growth potential for an ambitious IT professional but also requires proven experience with exponential growth on a global scale. You must be able to think creatively and work independently, presenting creative solutions to difficult networking problems.
   

  

**In this role, you will…**
 Ideal candidate will have a strong networking background working with multiple vendors including Cisco, Palo Alto, Juniper, Arista, F5, A10, Brocade, and Meraki.
   

  

 Day\-to\-day operational support of network infrastructure and services maintaining, highly available, high performance data center network infrastructure involving multiple distributed systems in both on premise and cloud environments.
   

  

 Specific responsibilities include configuration, administration, upgrade and maintenance of network switches, routers, load balancers, and firewalls.
   

  

 Troubleshoot technical issues with other technical staff and end\-users.
   

  

 Monitor and manage network security, traffic, and performance.
   

  

 Experience with several Network monitoring and administration tools: SolarWinds, Thousand Eyes, Panorama, New Relic, Grafana and Logic Monitor.
   

  

 Maintain Cornerstone’s global SaaS service ensuring all incidents are tracked and remediated, and changes are implemented under the auspices of Cornerstone’s policies and procedures.
   

  

 Develop documentation and diagrams supporting Standard Operating Procedure documents.
   

  

 Establishment of enterprise data network standards taking into account various in\-flight initiatives.
   

  

 Managing medium to large scale public and private IP address schemes.
   

  

 Work with your team members and peer groups to ensure the security, availability, resiliency, and compliance with industry and regulatory requirements (ISO, SOC 1/2, FedRamp, PCI) in a fast\-paced SaaS environment.
   

  

 Thorough understanding of network security aspects, common problems and solutions (ACL, firewall filtering, and VPN).
   

  

**You’ve Got What It Takes If You Have…**
 In\-depth knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP protocols, IP Addressing (DHCP, NAT, etc...), MPLS, VPN, VLANs, Load Balancing, and Wireless technologies.
   

  

 Proven experience in delivering network services and solutions in a mid\-size or larger enterprise.
   

  

 CCNA level experience is required; CCNP certification or higher is preferred.
   

  

 4y\- 6y years of network engineering in a datacenter environment.
   

  

 Experience with network change management control tools and policies.
   

  

 In\-depth knowledge of OSPF and BGP routing protocols. L2/L3 switching on enterprise class hardware, including Arista, Cisco, Juniper, and Brocade switches and routers.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience securing network environments with Palo Alto and Juniper Firewalls.
   

  

 F5 and A10 load balancers configuration and design principals.
   

  

 Must have extensive experience building scalable, highly available, mission critical network infrastructures.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Team Leader, Team player, Dependable and Flexible.
   

  

 Deep analytical, interpersonal, organizational, communication \& problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 Security compliance experience as it relates to the network.
   

  

 Demonstrated commitment to valuing diversity and contributing to an inclusive working and learning environment.
   

  

 Consideration for privacy and security obligations.
   

  

**Extra dose of awesome if you have…**
 Virtualization experience a plus.
   

  

 ITIL Certification a plus
   

  

 Note : This roles revolves across APAC and EMEA Shift and commute to office would be supported by Cabs ( Pick \& Drop )

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Consumer Internet)
description:
Machine Learning Engineer
   

  

**Locations:** 
 Hyderabad / Gurgaon (Full\-Time, 100% In\-Office)
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 1–4 Years
   

  

**Department:** 
 Data Science \& AI Engineering
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an ambitious, hands\-on
 **Machine Learning Engineer** 
 to build and scale intelligent algorithms that power our core consumer internet platform. Based out of our Hyderabad or Gurgaon technology centers, you will work closely with product, data, and engineering teams to design recommendation systems, personalization models, and predictive user\-behavior pipelines. You will take machine learning models from exploratory data analysis all the way to production microservices in a high\-energy, collaborative office environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Detailed Breakdown:** 
**1\. Model Development \& Training**
* Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models (ranging from gradient boosting and collaborative filtering to deep learning and NLP frameworks) to drive user engagement and personalization.
* Build robust feature engineering pipelines using large\-scale user interaction data, clickstream logs, and transactional records.
* Continuously monitor model performance in production, detect feature/concept drift, and retrain models to ensure high accuracy and relevance.
* Productionization \& MLOps
* Translate experimental code (Jupyter notebooks) into clean, modular, and scalable production\-ready Python code.
* Deploy models as low\-latency REST APIs or microservices using FastAPI, Docker, and container orchestration platforms.
* Optimize algorithmic inference latency to ensure real\-time responsiveness for millions of concurrent platform users.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Innovation
* Participate in daily in\-office standups, sprint planning sessions, and architecture reviews with backend engineers and product managers.
* Collaborate with data engineers to streamline data ingestion, storage, and feature store updates.
* Run rapid test\-and\-learn experimentation frameworks (A/B testing) to measure the business impact of deployed machine learning features.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
  

  

* Work Mode: 100% In\-Office (Based in Hyderabad or Gurgaon).
* Experience: 1 to 4 years of hands\-on software development and machine learning experience within fast\-paced Consumer Internet, E\-commerce, D2C, FinTech, or Tech Product companies.
* Core Technical Stack:
+ Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow).
+ Strong mastery of relational databases and complex SQL querying.
+ Experience building APIs using FastAPI or Flask and containerizing applications via Docker.

* Competencies: Strong problem\-solving skills, solid grounding in foundational statistics and algorithms, and an eagerness to collaborate face\-to\-face in a high\-energy tech hub.


**Why Join Us?**
 Operating out of our state\-of\-the\-art tech hubs in Hyderabad or Gurgaon, you will work directly alongside seasoned engineering leaders to deploy machine learning models that impact millions of users daily, offering rapid career growth and high technical ownership.
   

  

 Skills: pytorch,machine learning,consumer internet,pandas,tensorflow,machine learning models,fastapi,python,scikit\-learn

title: Associate Technical Unreal Artist
description:
**About Hexr Factory**
 Hexr Factory is a next\-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real\-time digital experiences.
   

  

 We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high\-impact solutions. From cutting\-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.
   

  

 At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading\-edge software engineering, design thinking and high\-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.
   

  

 This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem\-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We are looking for an Associate Technical Unreal Artist to help build, integrate, optimise and deliver real\-time 3D experiences in Unreal Engine. This is a hands\-on production role for someone who can bridge art and technical execution across scenes, assets, materials, lighting, Sequencer, rendering and interactive workflows.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Build, assemble, light and optimise real\-time 3D scenes and cinematic sequences in Unreal Engine.
* Integrate, organise, reimport and validate assets, materials, textures, animations and Blueprints.
* Set up and maintain Sequencer, cameras, lighting, Movie Render Queue and reliable final\-output pipelines.
* Diagnose rendering, lighting, shader, Blueprint and performance issues using evidence and profiling tools.
* Apply practical optimisation across draw calls, textures, shaders, LODs, lighting and scene complexity while protecting visual quality.
* Support technical\-art workflows for materials, Niagara effects, post\-processing, collision, packaging and platform\-specific output.
* Maintain clean project structure, naming conventions, version discipline and dependable handovers.
* Collaborate with artists, designers, engineers, leads and production teams; communicate trade\-offs and raise delivery risks early.
* Document repeatable workflows and contribute to tools, checklists and process improvements.
* Test new Unreal workflows carefully and adopt them when they improve quality, reliability or delivery speed.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 2–5 years of hands\-on Unreal Engine production experience in real\-time 3D, virtual production, XR, games, visualisation or a related field.
* Strong working knowledge of Unreal Engine, including level assembly, asset management, materials, lighting, Sequencer and Movie Render Queue.
* Practical understanding of Blueprints, technical troubleshooting, profiling and performance optimisation.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving issues across scenes, assets, shaders, lighting, rendering and interactive behaviour.
* Familiarity with Niagara, post\-processing, LODs, collision, packaging and source\-control workflows is preferred.
* Ability to read technical requirements, follow production standards and explain issues clearly to both technical and creative teammates.
* Strong attention to detail, structured problem\-solving and reliable follow\-through.
* Portfolio or showreel demonstrating personal contribution to Unreal Engine projects.
* Comfortable working on\-site in Chennai.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience supporting reusable tools, material functions, Blueprint utilities or technical\-art standards.
* Exposure to Python or other scripting for pipeline support and repetitive\-task automation.
* Experience collaborating in Agile or sprint\-based production environments.
