title: Game Designer - Silkgrove (RPG)
description:
Gallic Entertainment is looking for a Game Designer with Level Design experience to join the team working on Silkgrove, our single\-player open\-world adventure RPG.
 



  





 Full\-time \- Remote \- India \- Unreal Engine 5
 



  





**Please read it carefully before applying!** 




  





**About Silkgrove:** 




 Silkgrove is a cozy open\-world RPG about exploration, restoration, and rebuilding a world after a war between humans and machines.
 



 The game has a strong focus on
 **narrative, storytelling, worldbuilding, and exploration** 
 , with gameplay built around restoring the world, helping communities, discovering its history, and progressing through the environment.
 



  






 Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570350/Silkgrove/
 




  





 Our references include
 **My Time at Portia** 
 and
 **The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild** 
 , particularly in how they approach exploration, player freedom, progression, and world interaction.
 



  





**What we are looking for:** 




 We're not focused purely on years of experience.
 **2\+ years of professional Game Design experience is preferred** 
 , but we're also open to
 **early\-career candidates** 
 who have strong practical work, projects, or portfolios demonstrating their ability.
 



  





 More importantly, we're looking for someone genuinely interested in the type of game we're making.
 



 Who enjoys narrative\-driven, story\-focused, and exploration\-heavy games and understands what makes these experiences work.
 



  





 Since we're a small team, we're looking for someone whose primary focus is Game Design and Level Design, but who is also willing to contribute to other areas of the game when possible and when their skills can help.

**Company Description** 




 Evervie Health is a global healthcare group focused on building and scaling high\-quality specialty care across multiple therapeutic areas. Its platform currently spans Renal Care, Oncology, and Diagnostics. We are currently building a women's healthcare brand in India, with a digital platform that sits at the center of the patient \& provider experience.
 



  






 Why is it exciting to be part of this team? The leadership team brings decades of experience in healthcare technology and operations, with experience across 5\+ countries. Six out of eight senior leaders are women passionate about changing the paradigm for healthcare access. It's a deliberately small and senior team, and you'd be the first product hire working directly alongside them.
 




  





**Role Description** 




 The Product Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru/ Hyderabad or Chennai, responsible for driving the end\-to\-end lifecycle of healthcare products on Evervie Health’s platform.
 



 What you'll own:
 


* Turn our proprietary clinical logic and the journeys built around it into specs, user stories and acceptance criteria engineers can build against. This is the hardest problem in the role with no off\-the\-shelf playbook to copy
* Own the vendor relationship as a product leader, not a coordinator: you'll run discovery, scoping and sprint reviews, and hold the build to your spec on quality, scope and timeline
* Own product quality and user testing
* Define success metrics beyond delivery i.e. accuracy, adoption, and trust in algorithmic recommendations
* Coordinate the dependencies i.e. brand assets, clinical sign\-offs, third\-party integrations
* Track compliance milestones in partnership with legal/compliance.
* Report progress, risk, and budget status to leadership on a weekly cadence
* Own the post\-launch roadmap: triage production issues with the vendor, prioritize the next cycle of features, and manage the transition from build to steady\-state managed support



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3–5 years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally exposure to health\-tech, fin\-tech, or another regulated or high\-trust consumer product
* An undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a top\-tier institute (IIT/ IIM/ BITS/ NIT or equivalent); someone who can hold their own technically and analytically from day one
* Demonstrated experience managing an external development vendor or agency
* Familiarity with, or strong interest in, AI/LLM\-based product features, including how to think about evaluation, confidence thresholds and failure states in a clinical\-adjacent context
* Exposure to data privacy or regulatory frameworks (India's DPDP Act, HIPAA, GDPR, or similar) is a strong plus
* A genuine ownership mentality and comfort with 0\-to\-1 ambiguity: this is an early\-stage build with a fixed launch date, evolving scope, and a very small team



  





**Why join us** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product hire. The product architecture, the spec standard, and the way this team builds are all still unwritten; you'll be the one writing them.
 



  






 Women's healthcare in India is under\-built relative to how much it matters, and we're building for the premium end of it with clinical rigor. You'll take this from before\-it\-existed to public launch, and be part of the problem\-solving journey.

title: Product Manager II
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 
 Zeta
 
 ,
 
 Radix
 
 , and
 
 Titan
 
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Drive** 
 — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the role** 




 As a part of Product Management team, you will work with a team of other Product Managers, Designers and Analysts driving the execution of various zero to 1 Products. We are proponents of leveraging best in breed AI tools in every step of the Product Development lifecycle \- Strategy, UX, Development and Testing. This requires a very different product development mindset comprising a lean team, of senior resources, that are hands\-on and AI adept, resulting in ultra\-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will experience this unique approach to the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch to success.
 



  





**Job Location** 



* Bangalore, India (100% on\-site)



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Product Management** 



* Meticulously drive each feature from ideation, implementation, go live and adoption



**2\. User interview \& research** 



* Lead continuous user discovery through interviews, contextual inquiry and surveys to understand workflows, pain points, and decision criteria.
* Synthesize qualitative \+ quantitative insights into clear problem statements, personas/JTBD, journey maps, and prioritized opportunity areas.



**3\. Growth Hacking** 



* Measure Output metrics (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Engagement) and Input metrics (Conversion Funnels, Engagement) that matter
* Leverage Product Analytics Platforms (Mixpanel, Amplitude etc), Data Analytics Platforms (Metabase, Superset)
* Creative Feature Ideation to come up with Features that have maximum impact on the metrics that matter
* Leverage frameworks for Feature Prioritization



**4\. UX** 



* Drive the creation of delightful, intuitive and engaging user interfaces in collaboration with UX designers to drive user adoption and NPS



**5\. Forward deployment \& adoption (hands\-on)** 



* Act as a forward\-deployed PM to ensure successful customer implementation and adoption, embedded with teams to unblock integration, workflow changes, and rollout.
* Develop adoption playbooks: onboarding flows, enablement content, rollout checklists, admin guides, and best\-practice templates.



  





**Skills** 



* In depth understanding and knowledge of Statistics, Analytics, Business Intelligence, SQL, Product Analytics platforms
* Ability to interpret complex data sets and derive actionable insights
* In depth understanding and knowledge of technology platforms and their capabilities for Web and Mobile development
* Keen eye for design and aesthetics
* Excellent UX and copywriting skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience in conducting user research
* Meticulous in program management processes



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* 3 to 6 years in Product Management.
* Experience in AI\-native companies, startups, founding teams, or as a founder is preferred
* Software engineering/technical background

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Deployment Strategist based in India.**
 This role is focused on turning enterprise AI initiatives into successful, production\-ready deployments.
   

  

 You will work closely with customers to understand their workflows, systems, constraints, and desired outcomes.
   

  

 The position sits at the intersection of customer strategy, engineering, product, and execution.
   

  

 You will translate complex requirements into clear scopes, deployment plans, and measurable success criteria.
   

  

 From discovery and pilots through production rollout, you will own progress, remove blockers, and keep stakeholders aligned.
   

  

 You will also monitor deployed AI agents, identify improvement opportunities, and uncover additional use cases for customers.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership environment suited to someone who enjoys ambiguity, technical problem\-solving, and delivering tangible customer impact.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Lead discovery sessions with enterprise customers to understand business processes, workflows, technical environments, constraints, pain points, and success criteria.
* Define clear scopes, success metrics, integration requirements, and deployment plans for AI pilots and production rollouts.
* Translate customer requirements into actionable plans that engineering and product teams can execute effectively.
* Coordinate deployments across Product, Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and customer stakeholders, ensuring alignment on priorities and expected outcomes.
* Track project progress, timelines, dependencies, risks, and blockers, taking ownership of resolving issues or escalating them when necessary.
* Support production launches and validate that deployed solutions are functioning as intended and delivering measurable customer value.
* Monitor deployed AI agents and use real\-world performance and customer feedback to identify follow\-up improvements.
* Maintain close relationships with customer stakeholders and help ensure successful adoption of deployed solutions.
* Identify additional customer use cases, opportunities for expansion, and ways to increase the value delivered by AI\-powered systems.
* Spend time onsite with customers when required, working through real\-world technical and operational constraints and helping teams navigate complex questions.
* Contribute to a fast\-moving, collaborative environment where ambiguous problems require practical solutions, strong judgment, and a bias toward action.


**Requirements**
* 0–1 year of experience in a deployment\-focused, technical, execution\-oriented, or comparable role.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify priorities, and turn complex requirements into concrete and actionable plans.
* Comfortable understanding and discussing technical concepts such as APIs, MCP, data flows, integrations, and system architectures.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management skills and the ability to maintain alignment across customers, engineering, product, and other teams.
* High ownership mindset with a proactive approach to identifying problems, taking initiative, and driving work through to completion.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence and in building, deploying, and improving AI\-powered systems in real\-world environments.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast\-paced, and high\-growth environments where priorities can evolve quickly.
* A background in solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward\-deployed engineering, or similar customer\-facing technical roles is a plus.
* Prior hands\-on software engineering experience is advantageous.
* Experience supporting production software launches or enterprise deployments is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, adaptability, and willingness to learn new technologies and domains quickly.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote, full\-time opportunity open to candidates anywhere in India.
* Opportunity to work directly with enterprise customers on real\-world AI deployments.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge agentic AI technologies and enterprise AI use cases.
* High\-ownership role with significant exposure to Product, Engineering, and customer\-facing activities.
* Opportunity to solve complex technical and operational problems for large enterprise organizations.
* Hands\-on experience taking AI solutions from discovery and pilots through production deployment.
* Potential customer\-site exposure and opportunities to work through real\-world implementation challenges.
* Collaborative environment with a team of high\-agency builders and cross\-functional technical professionals.
* Strong opportunity to develop expertise across AI deployment, technical strategy, enterprise solutions, and customer success.
* Compensation and additional benefits are subject to the partner company’s applicable employment terms and policies.


**How Jobgether Works**
 We use an
 **AI\-powered matching process** 
 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
   

  

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
   

  

**Data Privacy Notice:** 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

**Position:** HR Recruiter Intern  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time Internship  
**Stipend/Pay:** ₹8,000 – ₹12,000 per month  
**Location:** Malad West Near NL College  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

About Knooviq Industries Pvt. Ltd.

Knooviq Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an **SAP Consulting and IT Solutions company** focused on helping organizations transform and optimize their business operations through enterprise technology. The company provides a range of **SAP consulting, implementation, application management, support, integration, outsourcing, and SAP S/4HANA solutions** to businesses across various industries.

This opportunity is specifically designed for **complete freshers** who want practical exposure to the recruitment process and are interested in building a long\-term career in HR.

Job Summary

We are looking for an enthusiastic **HR Recruiter Intern** to join our recruitment team.

As an HR Recruiter Intern, you will receive hands\-on exposure to the complete recruitment cycle, including **candidate sourcing, resume screening, recruitment calls, interview coordination, candidate follow\-ups, maintaining recruitment trackers, and onboarding support**.

No prior recruitment experience is required. We are looking for candidates with good communication skills, confidence, a positive attitude, and a strong willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities1\. Candidate Sourcing

* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, references, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Understand the Job Description (JD) and identify suitable candidate profiles.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of potential candidates.

2\. Resume Screening

* Review resumes according to the requirements of different job openings.
* Shortlist candidates based on qualifications, skills, experience, location, notice period, and other relevant criteria.
* Maintain accurate candidate information.

3\. Recruitment Calls

* Contact candidates through phone calls and explain job opportunities.
* Conduct initial HR screening discussions.
* Understand candidate expectations, availability, salary expectations, and career interests.
* Maintain professional communication with candidates.

4\. Interview Coordination

* Schedule interviews between candidates and the concerned hiring team/client.
* Share interview details and meeting links with candidates.
* Follow up with candidates before the interview to ensure attendance.
* Coordinate interview rescheduling whenever required.

5\. Candidate Follow\-Up

* Follow up with candidates after interviews for feedback and next steps.
* Maintain regular communication with shortlisted and selected candidates.
* Follow up with candidates until the joining process is completed.

6\. Recruitment Tracking \& Reporting

* Maintain daily recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Update sourcing, screening, interview, selection, and joining status.
* Prepare daily/weekly recruitment reports.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records.

7\. Job Posting

* Assist in creating and posting job openings on recruitment platforms.
* Support the team in improving job postings and candidate reach.

8\. HR \& Recruitment Support

* Assist the HR team with recruitment\-related documentation.
* Support onboarding activities whenever required.
* Assist with other HR activities and projects assigned by the reporting manager.

Who Can Apply?

This position is open to **complete freshers**.

We welcome candidates who are:

* Fresh graduates or final\-year students interested in HR.
* MBA/PGDM\-HR, BBA, B.Com, BA, or graduates from any relevant discipline.
* Candidates looking to start their career in Recruitment / Talent Acquisition.
* Candidates with **0 years of experience**.
* Candidates who are comfortable speaking with people over the phone.
* Immediate joiners are preferred.

**Previous HR or recruitment experience is NOT mandatory.**

Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Confidence while speaking with candidates.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Willingness to make recruitment calls.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Good follow\-up and time\-management skills.
* Ability to understand and follow Job Descriptions.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work in a target\-oriented environment.

**Knowledge of LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, Boolean Search, or recruitment tools will be an added advantage but is not mandatory.**

What You Will Learn

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**1\. Job Purpose**

To support the Quality Department in ensuring that raw materials, components, machining, fabrication, assembly and finished products meet the required **drawings, specifications, quality standards and customer requirements**.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**Incoming Quality Inspection**

* Inspect incoming raw materials, bought\-out components and engineering materials.
* Verify material dimensions, specifications, quantity and relevant certificates.
* Coordinate with Stores and Purchase for material inspection and acceptance.
* Identify and report defective or non\-conforming materials.

**In\-Process Quality Inspection**

* Conduct quality inspection at different stages of manufacturing.
* Inspect **fabrication, machining, welding, assembly and finishing** activities.
* Check components against approved drawings, specifications and inspection standards.
* Monitor critical dimensions and maintain inspection records.
* Identify defects at the earliest stage and coordinate for corrective action.

**Machine Shop Quality**

* Inspect components manufactured through **VMC, CNC, conventional machining and other machine\-shop processes**.
* Use measuring instruments such as:
* Vernier Caliper
* Micrometer
* Height Gauge
* Bore Gauge
* Dial Gauge
* Thread Gauges
* Welding gauges and other inspection tools.
* Verify dimensional accuracy as per engineering drawings.

**Fabrication \& Welding Quality**

* Inspect fabricated structures and components for dimensional accuracy.
* Check welding quality, weld size, alignment and visual defects.
* Coordinate with the fabrication team for rectification of quality issues.
* Monitor rework and rejection in fabrication.

**Final Inspection**

* Conduct final inspection of components, assemblies and completed machines.
* Verify dimensions, fitment, alignment, appearance and functionality.
* Ensure the product is released only after meeting defined quality requirements.
* Prepare and maintain final inspection reports.

**Documentation**

* Maintain inspection reports, rejection reports, rework records and quality check sheets.
* Prepare Non\-Conformance Reports (NCR) where required.
* Maintain calibration records for measuring instruments.
* Maintain traceability of inspection and quality documents.
* Support preparation of quality reports for management review.

**Quality Improvement**

* Analyse rejection, rework and customer complaints.
* Support **Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA)**.
* Participate in quality improvement activities.
* Support reduction of rework, rejection and material wastage.
* Follow and promote 5S and continuous improvement practices.

**Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with **Production, Design, Stores, Purchase, Project and Service Departments**.
* Communicate quality requirements clearly to production personnel.
* Escalate critical quality issues to the Quality Manager.
* Support customer and third\-party inspections when required.

**3\. Qualification**

* **Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (DME)** / **B.E. / B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering**
* Basic knowledge of engineering drawings and inspection methods is preferred.

**4\. Experience**

* **0–2 years** of experience in Quality / QC / Manufacturing.
* Freshers with good technical knowledge and interest in Quality may also be considered.
* Experience in **machine shop, fabrication, welding or engineering manufacturing** will be an advantage.

**5\. Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of mechanical inspection.
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings.
* Knowledge of GD\&T basics will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments.
* Basic knowledge of machining and fabrication processes.
* Basic knowledge of welding inspection.
* MS Excel and documentation skills.
* Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality systems is an advantage.

Pay: ₹10,999\.09 \- ₹39,472\.43 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

title: UX Designer
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We are seeking a talented UX Designer (Grade 26\) to join the UX Design team for Optum® Crimson AI \- an AI\-enabled clinical analytics and business intelligence platform used by hospitals and health systems across the U.S. Crimson AI integrates directly with a health system's EHR and brings clinical, financial, scheduling and supply chain data together into a single modular platform, layering predictive analytics, AI\-generated recommendations and a conversational AI experience on top of it. Analysis that once required weeks of manual data mining is now delivered in seconds.
   

  

 This is a design role in which data is the product. Our users come to Crimson AI to identify an opportunity, understand what is driving it, and decide what to do next. Your work makes that path short, clear and trustworthy.
   

  

 The role combines user experience design, product thinking, data visualization and AI\-enabled design capabilities to deliver solutions that meet customer needs and business objectives. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science and Business stakeholders, you will contribute to the design and evolution of complex digital products, transforming user insights and business requirements into engaging and effective experiences.
   

  

 We work in short, iterative cycles in each Sprint. Designers here are active participants in shaping the work rather than recipients of finished specifications \- you will help the team arrive at clarity rather than wait for it. Because our products sit on top of complex healthcare data and rapidly evolving AI capabilities, Product, Design, Data Science and Engineering deliberately open up a problem space together to build shared understanding, then converge quickly on a direction and deliver.
   

  

 We are a closely knit team that shares work early, critiques generously and holds a high bar for craft. You will have real ownership of your product areas, direct access to the people who understand the data and the domain, and colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving these problems together.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Create wireframes, prototypes, design concepts and high\-fidelity designs that effectively communicate product vision and functionality
* Apply user\-centered design methodologies to ensure usability, accessibility, and adoption
* Build a thorough working understanding of the product and the business behind it, and ask the incisive early questions that establish the real user problem, the intended business outcome and the measures of success \- then design against those rather than against a feature list
* Translate complex, multi\-source healthcare data into actionable insight. Develop a working understanding of how the underlying data relates \- what drives what, what can meaningfully be compared, and where the caveats sit \- and design the information hierarchy, data presentation and visualizations so that users can see the signal, trust it, and act on it
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis and user discovery activities to inform product and design decisions
* Translate complex business requirements, workflows, and data structures into intuitive and user\-friendly experiences
* Incorporate customer feedback, user research findings and market insights to refine designs and improve product outcomes
* Operate at pace: scope your own design approach, select the right fidelity for the decision at hand, and iterate as the team's understanding of the problem sharpens
* Perform AI\-driven product design and prototyping, and apply AI tooling to accelerate your own exploration and delivery
* Follow and help strengthen the defined UX guidelines, standards, and best practices across teams
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams throughout the product lifecycle to deliver high\-quality user experiences
* Participate in usability testing, stakeholder workshops, design reviews, and design\-thinking sessions
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment) The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in UX / Product Design, including hands\-on experience designing for data\-rich or analytics\-driven products
* Hands\-on experience with user research, usability testing, stakeholder workshops, and design sprint activities
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG / Section 508\) and inclusive design principles
* Proficiency in Figma and other industry\-standard design and prototyping tools
* Demonstrated product thinking: a track record of understanding product and business requirements quickly, asking the right questions of stakeholders, and producing design solutions that demonstrably serve both user needs and business goals. title: User Interface Designer
description:
**About the Role:\-** 




 We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to join our product team and take ownership of designing intuitive, scalable, and user\-friendly experiences across our product. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, and other stakeholders to understand user problems, translate requirements into thoughtful experiences, and take designs from concept to implementation. The ideal candidate is someone who can think beyond visual design — someone who understands user journeys, product workflows, information architecture, usability, and business requirements, while also having a strong eye for UI.
 



  





**What You'll Do:\-** 




 • Work closely with Product Managers to understand product requirements, user problems, and business objectives.
 



 • Translate product requirements and user needs into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
 



 • Design intuitive experiences for complex product workflows while keeping them simple for users. • Create and maintain design systems, reusable components, and UI patterns to ensure consistency across the product.
 



 • Conduct user research, usability analysis, and competitive benchmarking where required.
 



 • Identify UX gaps and proactively suggest improvements to existing product experiences.
 



 • Collaborate closely with engineering throughout the development cycle to ensure design intent is implemented accurately.
 



 • Review implemented features and provide design feedback before release.
 



 • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, product analytics, and stakeholder inputs.
 



 • Maintain design documentation and ensure design decisions are clearly communicated to the team.
 



 • Balance user needs, technical constraints, and business priorities when making design decisions.
 



  





**What We're Looking For:\-** 




 • 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX or Product Design, preferably working on SaaS, B2B, or technology products.
 



 • Strong understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design.
 



 • Experience designing complex workflows and products rather than only marketing websites or landing pages.
 



 • Strong proficiency in Figma and experience working with design systems and reusable components.
 



 • Ability to create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs.
 



 • Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills.
 



 • Good understanding of responsive design and common web application patterns.
 



 • Ability to explain and defend design decisions using user and product context rather than personal preferences.
 



 • Comfortable working in a fast\-paced product environment with evolving requirements.
 



 • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 



  





**Good to Have:\-** 




 • Experience designing B2B SaaS / enterprise products.
 



 • Experience working with chatbot, conversational AI, automation, or workflow\-based products.
 



 • Experience with usability testing and user research.
 



 • Familiarity with product analytics and using data to inform design decisions.
 



 • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and frontend development constraints.
 



 • Experience building and maintaining a design system from scratch.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like:\-** 




 • Users can complete key product workflows with minimal friction and confusion.
 



 • New features are designed with consistency and scalability in mind.
 



 • Product experiences become simpler and more intuitive over time.
 



 • Engineering teams have clear, implementation\-ready designs.
 



 • Design decisions are grounded in user needs, product objectives, and data.
 



 • The product maintains a consistent and high\-quality visual and interaction language.

title: Visual Designer
description:
**Visual Designer** 




*Own the visual identity of a fast\-growing, Accel\-backed AI startup* 
 Fibr AI \| HSR Layout, Bangalore \| Full\-Time \| In\-office
 



  





 About the Role
 



 Got an eye for design and a love for making complex things look effortless? This is your shot to own the entire visual language of Fibr.ai, across marketing, brand, product storytelling, and social. Your work will directly shape how a fast\-growing AI startup shows up to the world. You'll work hand in hand with founders and the marketing team, turning bold ideas into visuals that are modern, memorable, and impossible to scroll past.
 



  





 What Working With Us Looks Like
 


* Your work won't just live inside Fibr's own brand. You'll often get to shape how other respected businesses present themselves visually, including reimagining their web presence end to end. That's a level of trust and credibility not every design role offers this early in a career.
* You'll work directly with founders and the marketing team, with real access to decision makers, fast feedback loops, and the chance to shape brand direction early on, not just execute a brief.
* You'll work across a rich mix of formats, from product explainers to campaign content to decks, and get to enjoy real variety in what you design day to day.
* You take creative briefs and run with them, bringing your own point of view while staying aligned with brand direction.
* You're a proactive problem solver, someone who spots what needs attention and acts on it rather than waiting to be asked.
* Great design here is a craft we shape together. You'll collaborate closely with the team to refine ideas until they truly land.
* As an early stage team, roles flex a bit. One week might be pure visual design, another might involve jumping in on a campaign asset. We love people who enjoy that kind of variety.
* We're building something long term, and we're looking for someone excited to grow with the company and the mission.



  





 Your Work Will Include (a.k.a. What You'll Get To Create)
 


1. Designing marketing graphics, campaign assets, website visuals, and product explainers
2. Creating social content, email graphics, ads, landing page assets, and presentation decks
3. Producing UI inspired visuals that bring our product story alive
4. Contributing to brand evolution, visual identity, and creative direction
5. *(Preferred)* 
 Creating short motion graphics, animations, and micro interactions
6. Collaborating with product teams to maintain a cohesive design system
7. Brainstorming creative concepts for launches, campaigns, and events



  





 Culture \& Values
 


* Founder close, low bureaucracy: We're a small, AI native team of about 30 people. You'll have direct visibility into decisions and direction, not layers of sign off.
* Ownership over instructions: We value people who take a problem and run with it, not just execute tasks.
* Craft over speed alone: We care about getting things right. Design here is refined collaboratively, not rushed and forgotten.
* We celebrate the people, not just the output
* We build community, not just a workplace: in office meals, pantry snacks, and monthly turf sports evenings help the team stay connected outside of pure work.
* AI first mindset: we expect and encourage the use of AI tools across design, content, and workflows. This is core to how we operate, not an afterthought.
* Long term builders wanted: we're looking for people who want to grow with the company's mission, not just a role or a single manager.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 Must have skills:
 


1. About 2 years of experience as a visual designer, graphic designer, or brand designer
2. Strong design fundamentals: layout, typography, color, composition
3. Proficiency with Illustrator, Canva, and Figma
4. Ability to think visually and translate product concepts into clean, modern graphics (bonus if you also know Framer)
5. A self starter mindset, comfortable taking a brief and running with it, and equally comfortable asking for direction when needed
6. Enjoys collaborating closely with the team to shape and refine ideas until they land well
7. Creativity, attention to detail, and a product focused design mindset
8. Ability to deliver high quality work across multiple formats (web, social, presentations)
9. Comfortable working with AI tools for design (Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, etc.)
10. Experience with AI image generation, prompt crafting, and AI assisted creative workflows
11. Strong work ethic and reliability, someone the team can count on
12. Portfolio and resume required; a portfolio of past work is highly preferred



  





 Preferred but not mandatory:
 


1. Motion graphics or animation experience (After Effects, Premiere, or similar)
2. Hands on experience with Framer (big plus), or familiarity with Webflow and website design principles
3. Experience designing for SaaS, AI, or tech products
4. Prior startup or fast paced environment experience



  





 Skills
 



 Graphic Design, Design, Visual Design, UI/UX Design, Brand Design \& Strategy

title: Head of Talent Acquisition
description:
**Head of Talent Acquisition**

**Invisia Software Pvt. Ltd. \| Bengaluru, Kalyan Nagar \| Full\-time**

**Function:** People \& Culture  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Kalyan Nagar, On\-site  
**Experience:** 10–15 years  
**Reporting To:** CHRO / Executive Leadership  
**Team:** 2–4 TA professionals initially  
**Industry Preference:** SaaS / Product Technology

**About Invisia Software**

Invisia Software is a growing product technology company headquartered in Bengaluru. As the organization scales its product, technology and business functions, we are strengthening our Talent Acquisition function to build a predictable, high\-quality and scalable hiring capability.

**Role Overview**

The Head of Talent Acquisition will own the complete Talent Acquisition function, from workforce and hiring planning through recruitment strategy, team management, sourcing, execution, funnel performance and hiring outcomes.

This is a hands\-on functional leadership role. The successful candidate will partner with leadership and functional heads to translate business and workforce requirements into executable hiring plans, establish TA goals and processes, build and manage the TA team, personally support critical hiring, and ensure recruitment performance meets agreed quality, timeline and cost expectations.

The role is expected to establish a TA function that operates with clear ownership, measurable performance, reliable forecasting and limited dependency on continuous senior leadership intervention.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Workforce and Hiring Planning**

* Partner with leadership, HR and functional heads to translate annual and quarterly business plans into workforce and hiring requirements.
* Validate requirements based on business priority, role necessity, skill availability, compensation and market conditions.
* Develop quarterly and monthly hiring plans with priorities, timelines, recruiter capacity, sourcing approach, dependencies and risks.
* Forecast TA capacity required to deliver approved hiring plans.
* Maintain forward\-looking talent pipelines for anticipated and difficult\-to\-fill requirements.
* Provide realistic hiring forecasts and proactively escalate risks with corrective actions.

**TA Strategy and Functional Ownership**

* Own the Talent Acquisition strategy, operating model and performance of the function.
* Translate organizational hiring goals into departmental goals and individual recruiter KRAs/KPIs.
* Establish recruitment processes, playbooks, SLAs, interview frameworks and governance.
* Build an appropriate TA team structure and develop internal recruitment capability.
* Evaluate TA tools, sourcing channels, agencies and external partners based on performance and business requirements.
* Continuously identify and resolve structural recruitment issues.

**Hiring Delivery**

* Own delivery of the approved hiring plan across Technology, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, HR and leadership positions.
* Personally lead or support critical, niche, senior and difficult\-to\-fill positions.
* Maintain strong hands\-on capability in sourcing, talent mapping, screening, assessment, candidate engagement and offer negotiation.
* Ensure recruitment delivery meets agreed quality, timeline and cost expectations.
* Build proactive pipelines for recurring and strategically important talent requirements.

**TA Team Leadership and Performance**

* Lead, coach and develop the TA team.
* Allocate requisitions based on priority, complexity, capacity and recruiter capability.
* Establish individual and team goals, KPIs and performance expectations.
* Conduct structured weekly pipeline and performance reviews.
* Identify capability and performance gaps and implement appropriate development or corrective actions.
* Build team capability to reduce dependency on individual recruiters or external agencies.

**Recruitment Funnel Management**

* Own performance across the complete recruitment funnel from sourcing through joining.
* Establish appropriate funnel benchmarks by role category.
* Monitor conversion, aging, candidate withdrawals, interview no\-shows, offer declines and joining drop\-offs.
* Diagnose whether underperformance originates from sourcing, screening, requirement calibration, assessments, interviewer quality, compensation, candidate engagement or other factors.
* Implement corrective actions when funnel performance falls below expectations.
* Prevent repeated poor\-quality submissions from consuming unnecessary hiring\-manager and leadership bandwidth.

**Hiring Manager Governance**

* Establish structured requisition intake and role\-calibration processes.
* Ensure role requirements, competencies, assessment methods, compensation and timelines are aligned before sourcing begins.
* Establish appropriate SLAs for profile review, interviews, feedback and hiring decisions.
* Use market evidence and recruitment data to challenge unrealistic or inconsistent requirements.
* Conduct recalibration where repeated candidate rejection indicates misalignment.
* Support hiring managers in structured interviewing and objective candidate evaluation.

**Analytics, Forecasting and Reporting**

* Establish and maintain TA dashboards covering hiring plan versus actual, requisition aging, forecasted closures, funnel conversions, offer acceptance, offer\-to\-join, source effectiveness, recruiter productivity, agency performance and critical hiring risks.
* Provide leadership with clear weekly and monthly hiring\-health reporting.
* Distinguish positions that are on track, at risk or critical and provide corrective actions and expected resolution timelines.
* Maintain ATS discipline and ensure reliable recruitment data and reporting.

**Vendor and Agency Management**

* Determine where external recruitment support is appropriate.
* Manage recruitment agencies, executive search firms and specialist sourcing partners.
* Establish candidate\-quality expectations, SLAs and commercial terms.
* Track vendor performance based on quality, conversion, closures, TAT and cost.
* Optimize agency usage and reduce unnecessary external dependency.

**Employer Branding and Talent Market**

* Own TA requirements and strategy relating to employer positioning and candidate experience.
* Partner with HR, Marketing and Creative on careers content, employee stories and recruitment campaigns.
* Develop employee referral and relevant talent\-community initiatives.
* Monitor candidate experience and recruitment\-related employer reputation.
* Represent the organization at relevant hiring and talent events where appropriate.

**Role Boundaries**

The Head of Talent Acquisition is not the primary owner of:

* HR operations, payroll or general HR administration.
* Employee relations or organization\-wide performance management.
* Learning and Development or Compensation and Benefits.
* Marketing or employer\-brand content production.
* Routine onboarding administration following recruitment handover.
* Final technical evaluation of specialist candidates.
* Business headcount decisions or justification of workforce requirements on behalf of functional leaders.

Functional leaders remain accountable for identifying and justifying business capability and headcount requirements. The Head of TA is responsible for validating, translating and executing approved workforce requirements through an effective recruitment strategy.

**First 90 Days: Expected Outcomes**

**First 30 Days**

* Complete current\-state assessment of TA processes, people, tools and vendors.
* Validate open requisitions, priorities and hiring requirements with functional heads.
* Establish baseline hiring plan and recruitment funnel metrics.
* Assess recruiter capacity and capability.
* Review ATS discipline, agency performance and existing sourcing channels.
* Identify critical hiring risks and implement immediate interventions.
* Present recommended TA operating model and priority improvement plan.

**Days 31–60**

* Implement quarterly/monthly hiring plan and requisition prioritization.
* Establish recruiter allocation and capacity planning.
* Cascade TA goals into individual recruiter KRAs/KPIs.
* Establish weekly TA operating and performance reviews.
* Implement hiring\-manager intake, calibration and SLA processes.
* Operationalize TA dashboard and hiring forecasts.
* Implement agency/vendor scorecards.
* Establish structured interview and evaluation frameworks.
* Begin proactive talent mapping for critical positions.

**Days 61–90**

* Establish reliable hiring plan versus actual reporting and monthly closure forecasting.
* Demonstrate measurable recruiter productivity and accountability.
* Establish visibility and intervention mechanisms for critical\-role pipelines.
* Demonstrate active management of recruitment funnel bottlenecks.
* Establish measurable hiring\-manager and agency performance.
* Improve ATS and recruitment\-data discipline.
* Present TA team capacity and capability recommendations.
* Present a six\-month TA improvement and hiring roadmap.

**Key Result Areas**

**KRA \- Weight**

Workforce and Hiring Planning \-15%

Hiring Delivery and Critical Role Closure \- 25%

TA Team Performance and Capability \- 15%

Sourcing Strategy and Pipeline Health \- 10%

Recruitment Funnel Performance \- 15%

Hiring Manager Governance \- 10%

Analytics, Forecasting and Process Governance \- 5%

Vendor, Employer Brand and Talent Ecosystem \- 5%

**Total \- 100%**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of Talent Acquisition experience, preferably with significant exposure to SaaS, product or technology organizations.
* Minimum 4–5 years of experience directly managing TA professionals.
* Demonstrated experience owning a TA function or substantial recruitment portfolio.
* Proven ability to translate workforce requirements into structured hiring plans and execution.
* Strong experience establishing recruiter goals, KPIs, processes and operating cadences.
* Proven track record of technology, product and business\-function recruitment.
* Strong hands\-on sourcing, talent mapping and passive candidate engagement capability.
* Experience personally closing difficult mid\-to\-senior and leadership positions.
* Demonstrated recruitment funnel analysis, hiring forecasting and problem\-solving capability.
* Experience building or significantly improving recruitment processes and assessment frameworks.
* Strong hiring\-manager and senior stakeholder management.
* Experience managing recruitment agencies and external search partners.
* Strong understanding of ATS, recruitment analytics and data\-driven TA management.

**Preferred:** Executive search, startup/scale\-up, employer branding, high\-volume recruitment or experience building a TA function from an early or less mature stage.

**Overall Accountability**

The Head of Talent Acquisition is accountable for delivering the approved workforce hiring plan within agreed quality, timeline and cost parameters while building a capable TA team, maintaining healthy recruitment funnels and providing leadership with reliable hiring forecasts and clear accountability.

description:

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
**Job ID:**

R0138436

2026\-09\-08
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY TECHNOLOGY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
**Profession (Job Category):**

Full time

**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity**

At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to creating a sustainable energy future through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. We are looking for a Compensation \& Benefits Analyst to join our Global HR Services team and play a critical role in delivering compensation and benefits support across multiple geographies.


In this role, you will partner with HR teams, business leaders, employees, and external vendors to ensure the efficient administration of compensation programs and employee benefits. You will be responsible for supporting key annual compensation processes, maintaining data accuracy within Workday, providing insightful reporting and analytics, and ensuring a high level of service delivery to stakeholders worldwide.


This position offers an excellent opportunity to gain global exposure while working on complex compensation programs, incentive plans, salary reviews, and benefits administration. You will collaborate with colleagues across regions, contribute to process improvements, and help drive operational excellence within a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


As part of a high\-performing HR Services organization, you will leverage analytical thinking, digital tools, and process expertise to enhance employee experience, ensure compliance, and support strategic business objectives. If you are detail\-oriented, customer\-focused, and passionate about compensation and benefits, this role provides an exciting platform for professional growth and impact.


**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentive (STI) programs, Long\-Term Incentive (LTI) programs, scorecards, and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.
* Administer compensation programs across multiple countries and regulatory environments while maintaining compliance with company policies and local requirements.
* Maintain, validate, and monitor compensation\-related employee data in Workday, ensuring data integrity and accuracy across HR systems.
* Generate standard and ad hoc compensation reports, analytics, and insights to support global and regional stakeholders in decision\-making.
* Coordinate and support regional and global employee benefits programs, including vendor management and service delivery activities.
* Manage end\-to\-end compensation transactions, including data validation, calculations, approvals, and payout readiness through established workflows and systems such as ServiceNow.
* Ensure delivery of compensation services in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) to ensure process consistency and compliance.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service excellence.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional and global teams while leveraging digital and analytical tools to improve productivity and decision\-making.

**Your Background**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in HR Shared Services, Compensation Operations, or Compensation \& Benefits Administration within a global organization.
* Hands\-on experience supporting compensation programs, including Annual Salary Reviews (ASR), Short\-Term Incentives (STI), Long\-Term Incentives (LTI), salary administration, and compensation reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, including compensation data management, reporting, and process administration.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of PowerPoint, Power BI, and other digital reporting tools.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Experience supporting employee benefits administration and vendor coordination is preferred.

**More About Us**

At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and continuous learning is supported.


Joining our team means working alongside talented professionals across the globe while contributing to meaningful work that supports employees and business success. We offer opportunities for career growth, global exposure, and professional development in an environment built on integrity, safety, and respect.


**Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.**

**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**

**Customer Support Intern**

**Location:** Pune**Employment Type:** Internship**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 year**Company:** Celoxis

**About Celoxis**

Celoxis is a global Project Portfolio Management (PPM) platform used by organizations to plan projects, manage resources, track financials, collaborate, and make better business decisions.

We are looking for curious, customer\-focused graduates who enjoy solving problems and want to build a career in SaaS, customer support, and technology.

**Role Overview**

As a **Customer Support Intern**, you will be part of the team responsible for helping Celoxis customers successfully use and troubleshoot the product.

This is not just a ticket\-handling role. You will learn how a B2B SaaS product works, understand real customer business problems, investigate technical issues, and communicate solutions clearly.

You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Respond to customer questions through support tickets, email, chat, and calls.
* Understand customer issues and identify the actual problem before suggesting a solution.
* Learn the Celoxis product in depth, including projects, tasks, resources, timesheets, reports, workflows, and administration.
* Reproduce customer\-reported issues and document clear reproduction steps.
* Troubleshoot functional and basic technical issues using application settings, logs, browser developer tools, APIs, and other available diagnostic information.
* Guide customers through product configuration and recommended approaches.
* Escalate product defects and complex technical issues with complete supporting information.
* Work with Product and Engineering teams to follow issues through to resolution.
* Keep customers updated on the progress of their queries.
* Create and improve internal troubleshooting documentation and knowledge\-base content.
* Identify recurring customer problems and share feedback that can help improve the product and customer experience.
* Participate in product testing and validation of fixes or new releases when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

We care more about your ability to **learn, think, communicate, and solve problems** than prior work experience.

You should have:

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, BCA, BSc Computer Science, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Good analytical and logical reasoning skills.
* Curiosity to understand how software works instead of simply following predefined steps.
* Ability to break a problem into smaller parts and troubleshoot systematically.
* Patience and professionalism while communicating with customers.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and business concepts.
* Good attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to take ownership of a problem and follow it through to resolution.

**Good to Have**

Prior knowledge is not mandatory, but exposure to any of the following will be helpful:

* SQL and relational databases
* REST APIs, JSON, HTTP, and web applications
* Browser Developer Tools
* Basic networking concepts
* Linux / Windows command line
* Java or general programming concepts
* SaaS applications
* Project management concepts
* Tools such as Postman, Zendesk, Jira, or similar platforms

**What You Will Learn**

During the internship, you will gain hands\-on exposure to:

* Enterprise SaaS customer support
* Project and Portfolio Management concepts
* Technical troubleshooting
* APIs and integrations
* Database and application fundamentals
* Customer communication and expectation management
* Product testing and defect reporting
* Working with Product and Engineering teams
* Handling real\-world enterprise customer scenarios

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Customer Support Intern at Celoxis will gradually be able to:

* Understand customer requirements without relying heavily on others.
* Troubleshoot issues methodically.
* Provide accurate and easy\-to\-understand responses.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, product limitations, and potential defects.
* Write high\-quality escalation notes that help Engineering investigate quickly.
* Take ownership of customer queries from initial investigation through resolution.
* Build strong product knowledge and become a dependable member of the Customer Support team.

**Who Would Enjoy This Role?**

You may be a strong fit if you enjoy questions such as:

**“Why is this happening?”**

**“Can I reproduce this?”**

**“What changed?”**

**“Is this configuration, expected behaviour, or a bug?”**

**“How can I explain the solution clearly to the customer?”**

If you enjoy solving puzzles, learning software, interacting with people, and understanding both the technical and business side of a problem, this role can be a strong starting point for your career in SaaS.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

About StarClinch

StarClinch is India's largest artist booking and discovery platform. Since 2015 we've owned the full booking journey \- shortlist, availability, negotiation, booking, payment, and escrow \- for singers, bands, dancers, photographers, and performers across weddings, corporate, and private events. We're a lean, tech\-first team building fast.

**About the Role**

You own hiring end to end, across every function, from engineering and product through sales, marketing, and ops. You're the first and most consistent StarClinch voice a candidate hears, so you can explain what we do, why it's a real market, and what the tech and business actually look like. Small team, so you run the whole cycle yourself.

**What you'll own**

* Full\-cycle recruitment across all roles: intake, sourcing, screening, offers, close.
* Source and screen credibly for both tech and sales, holding a real first conversation with an engineer or a sales candidate, not just scheduling one.
* Run Zoho Recruit as the single source of pipeline truth.
* Partner with hiring managers to scope roles and drive feedback SLAs so candidates don't stall.
* Manage offers to close and, critically, to join. No\-show is the real risk here, not the accept.
* Hand off cleanly to onboarding (BGV, GreytHR); you own everything up to the close.

**What we're looking for**

* 2\+ years of full\-cycle **in\-house** recruiting at a startup (agency background fine, but in\-house ownership is the bar).
* Proven strength hiring **tech, sales and other non\-tech roles**. Non\-negotiable; our pipeline is genuinely mixed.
* Comfortable owning an ATS end to end.
* Strong written and spoken English; you represent StarClinch clearly and warmly to candidates.
* Startup fluency: ambiguity, speed, multiple hats, hiring managers who aren't full\-time recruiters.
* Can explain StarClinch's business and tech to a candidate without hand\-holding.

**Nice to have**

* GreytHR familiarity (our HRIS/payroll).
* Hiring for marketplace, consumer\-tech, or events businesses.
* Campus / intern pipeline experience.

Benefits

* 27 days of paid leave a year \- generous time off to rest and recharge, well above the statutory minimum.
* Health and accidental insurance coverage \- so you and your peace of mind are protected from day one.
* Startup exposure — a young, dynamic team and the kind of fast, ownership\-driven environment where you see your work land.
* Learn and own the HR tech stack \- get hands\-on with modern HRMS, ATS, and AI\-driven HR tools, with the freedom to adopt what makes the function smarter.
* Mentoring and coaching from a senior HR leader \- direct access to experienced guidance as you take on bigger calls.
* Build from scratch \- freedom to experiment and design HR systems, not inherit red tape.
* Real influence \- a high\-impact role shaping team building and company culture from the front.

**About the Role**

OX Agry Pvt Ltd is looking for a **Customer Relationship Executive (CRE)** to manage the end\-to\-end machinery\-service relationship through our **digital platform**.

This is a **customer relationship, booking, and operations coordination role — not a telecalling role**.

You will coordinate the complete service journey from **farmer booking to machinery allocation, field coordination, work completion, and customer feedback**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the **end\-to\-end customer relationship** throughout the machinery\-service journey.
* Handle farmer and machinery\-owner queries and booking requests.
* Manage and coordinate machinery bookings through the OX Agry digital platform.
* Check booking requirements and allocate suitable machinery based on availability.
* Explain machinery services, offers, pricing, and availability to customers.
* Schedule machinery and coordinate with machinery owners and operators.
* Follow up on bookings until the farm work is successfully completed.
* Handle operational queries from farmers, machinery owners, and operators.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve operational issues.
* Maintain strong relationships with farmers and collect post\-service feedback.
* Escalate complaints and recurring issues appropriately.
* Accurately update booking and operational information in the OX Agry application.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline or equivalent.

**Experience**

* **2–10 years** of relevant experience in customer relationship, operations, coordination, or customer\-facing roles.
* Candidates with **0–2 years of experience** may apply for the **Customer Relationship Executive Internship**.
* The internship will provide practical exposure to customer relationship management, digital platform operations, machinery bookings, and service coordination.
* Based on performance and business requirements, successful interns may be considered for **full\-time employment after completing the 3\-month internship**.

**Language Skills**

* Fluency in Tamil is essential.
* Basic English reading and writing skills.

**Technical Skills**

* Comfortable using **computers, smartphones, and mobile applications**.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Comfortable handling operational calls with farmers, machinery owners, and operators.
* Ability to use digital platforms to update bookings, customer details, and operational information.
* Basic English for application usage and simple reports.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-through.
* Good problem\-solving ability.
* Active listening skills.
* Ability to manage multiple bookings and follow\-ups.
* Patient and calm approach while handling customer concerns.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders.

**Agricultural Knowledge**

* Knowledge of agricultural machinery, farming terms, or agricultural services is **not required**.
* Candidates with such knowledge may have an added advantage.
* Relevant product, process, machinery\-service, and basic agricultural knowledge will be covered as part of the training provided after joining.

**Work Location \& Schedule**

* **Location:** Palani, Tamil Nadu
* **Work Mode:** Work from Office
* **First Shift:** 7:00 AM – 4:30 PM
* **Second Shift:** 10:30 AM – 8:00 PM
* **Shift Rotation:** Weekly rotation between first and second shifts
* **Weekly Off:** One rotational weekly off
* **Work from Home:** Not available

**Salary \& Benefits**

**Salary:** Based on experience and finalized during the offer discussion.

**Performance Incentives:** Performance\-based seasonal incentives may be applicable during peak agricultural seasons. Incentives are variable, non\-guaranteed, and subject to business requirements and management discretion.

**Career Growth**

**Customer Relationship Executive → Senior Executive → Operations Team Lead**

This role provides an opportunity to build a career in a **digital platform\-driven AgriTech environment**.

**You will gain practical experience in:**

* Digital platform operations
* Customer relationship management
* Machinery booking and service coordination
* Agricultural technology and machinery\-service operations
* Field\-level coordination
* Stakeholder management
* End\-to\-end service operations

As you gain experience and demonstrate strong performance, you can progress into senior customer relationship and operations leadership roles.

**Selection Process**

* **Application Review** – Resume screening
* **Round 1:** Aptitude \& Operations Scenario Test – 45 minutes
* **Round 2:** Communication \& Language Assessment – 30 minutes
* **Round 3:** Role\-Based Interview – 30 minutes
* **Round 4:** Managerial Interview
* **Round 5:** HR Interview – 15 minutes

All interviews are scheduled rounds.

**Why Join OX Agry Pvt Ltd?**

* **Work with a digital\-first AgriTech platform** that connects farmers, machinery owners, and operators through technology.
* **Gain hands\-on experience with a real\-world digital platform** used to manage machinery bookings and agricultural service operations.
* **Build expertise in technology\-driven customer relationship and operations management.**
* **Gain practical experience in agricultural technology and machinery\-service operations** while working directly with customers and operational stakeholders.
* **Develop skills in digital booking, service coordination, and end\-to\-end service operations.**
* **Work closely with farmers, machinery owners, and operators** as part of a technology\-enabled agricultural ecosystem.
* **Build a career at the intersection of digital platforms, customer relationship management, and agricultural operations.**
* **Grow into higher responsibilities** in customer relationship and operations leadership.

**Interested in Joining OX Agry?**

Join OX Agry Pvt Ltd and build your career while working with a **digital AgriTech platform transforming the way agricultural machinery services are coordinated and delivered**.

* Be confident operating within a fast\-paced environment, able to drive conversation quickly across multiple teams.

* Participate in system testing, payroll implementations, process improvements \& payroll projects.

* Performs vendor management activities to ensure adherence to corporate vendor management standards.
* Review team members work; including but not limited to review of payroll input and manual calculations.
* Acquire knowledge of other team members’ payroll activities and perform back up support.

* Experience with payroll processing including; payroll production, reconciliation,
* Attention to detail

**Job Description**

  

Inviting applications for the role of **Manager**, **Non‑Financial Risk Management (NFRM)**

**The Manager leads delivery for a Large Global Insurance Company across its Non Financial Risk Management (NFRM) framework, with a focus on Risk and Control assessment (RCA) and Control Testing.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This role oversees a team of Consultants and Senior Consultants, ensuring high quality execution, review, and governance of NFRM activities.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Managers are responsible for end to end planning, resource allocation, stakeholder engagement, and maintaining delivery rigor. The role requires strong subject matter expertise, team leadership, and the ability to operate independently within a global risk environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**1\. RCA (Risk \& Control Assessment) – Leadership \& Review**

* Execute and own end‑to‑end RCAs across complex non‑IT risk areas such as fraud, Payroll, AP, AR, Procurement, HR, sanctions governance, mis‑selling, product governance, regulatory change, third‑party risk, and claims or underwriting failures
* Apply professional judgement to assess risk impact, control sufficiency, and residual risk
* Ensure RCA outcomes are defensible, consistent, and aligned to business reality
* Research and identify emerging non‑IT risks and embed them into RCA frameworks and workshop agendas
* Integrate RCA outcomes into testing scope and control focus areas

 **2\. Control Testing – Oversight \& Quality Control**

* Own end‑to‑end control testing execution for complex non‑IT processes including financial crime controls, conduct controls, third‑party governance, claims and underwriting processes, and reporting accuracy
* Define testing approaches, sampling strategies, and evidence expectations
* Personally execute judgement‑heavy tests and conclude on design and operating effectiveness
* Assess exceptions and perform first‑level conclusions on operating effectiveness
* Drive remediation discussions with business stakeholders for control failures

**3\. Delivery Management, Stakeholder Alignment \& Governance**

* Execute and own end‑to‑end RCAs across complex non‑IT risk areas such as fraud, Payroll, AP, AR, Procurement, HR, sanctions governance, mis‑selling, product governance, regulatory change, third‑party risk, and claims or underwriting failures
* Apply professional judgement to assess risk impact, control sufficiency, and residual risk
* Ensure RCA outcomes are defensible, consistent, and aligned to business reality
* Research and identify emerging non‑IT risks and embed them into RCA frameworks and workshop agendas
* Integrate RCA outcomes into testing scope and control focus areas

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate degree in Finance, Risk, Business, or Management strongly preferred

**Preferred qualifications \& Relevant Experience**
---------------------------------------------------

* Relevant experience in non‑IT risk management, internal audit, compliance, or control assurance roles in Insurance or other BFSI
* Demonstrated hands‑on experience executing RCAs/control testing across complex business processes
* Strong understanding of financial crime, conduct, regulatory, operational and governance risk frameworks
* Professional certification such as CA, CPA, CIA, CFE, or MBA typically expected

 .

**Qualification and Experience** 



* 12–18 years of progressive HR \& IR experience, with at least 5 years as HR/IR Head in a large/medium size textile unit (spinning/weaving/denim preferred).

* Deep knowledge of Indian labor laws and contractor workforce management.
* Strong communication in Hindi; local dialect proficiency desirable.
* Hands\-on leader with shop\-floor presence and problem\-solving orientation.



  





**Key competencies** 



* Strategic IR management \& conflict resolution.
* Workforce planning \& productivity orientation.
* Stakeholder influence (workers, management, authorities).
* Discipline, integrity, and resilience under pressure.
* Data\-driven HR systems \& compliance focus



  





**Success measure** 



* Zero mandays lost and stable IR climate at the factory
* Reduction in absenteeism, attrition, and overtime.
* Faster hiring turnaround and healthy position occupancy
* 100% statutory compliance.
* Productivity improvement through engagement and incentive schemes
* Effective cost management in HR \& IR budgets
