 As a Science Annotation Operations Analyst, you'll own end\-to\-end data pipelines that extract, validate, and consolidate annotation metrics from AWS and SageMaker. You'll build production dashboards, create custom annotation interfaces, and automate critical workflows—all while collaborating with Program Managers, Science Specialists, and cross\-functional teams. This role offers you the opportunity to leverage Python, AWS services, and web development skills to solve real problems that impact both customers and the planet.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and maintain scalable data pipelines that extract, parse, validate, and consolidate annotation metrics from AWS and SageMaker, ensuring data quality and auditability throughout the lifecycle
* Build and operate production dashboards on EC2 covering the full data lifecycle (ingest, validate, score, publish) using technologies like Plotly Dash or Streamlit
* Implement secure, least\-privilege cross\-account AWS integrations using IAM, STS, Lambda, and API Gateway to enable seamless data ingestion from multiple source accounts
* Develop custom SageMaker Ground Truth labeling templates using HTML and JavaScript with conditional logic that transform written SOPs into validated annotation interfaces
* Automate recurring manual processes including monthly consolidation, historical backfills, and scheduled jobs while maintaining alerting, backups, and deployment workflows to improve operational efficiency


 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll collaborate with Program Managers, Leads, and Science Annotations Specialists to tackle technical challenges that span the data lifecycle. You could start with debugging a Python script that processes annotation metrics with pandas and boto3, followed by deploying a new dashboard feature to EC2\. Later, you could be writing SQL queries to validate data quality, configuring IAM policies for secure cross\-account access, or building a new annotation UI template in HTML and JavaScript. You'll use Git for version control and Linux command\-line tools to manage deployment workflows, all while serving as the technical POC for your team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce \& Sustainability team is dedicated to making zero happen—zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We're an agile and inclusive organization that innovates to create long\-term value by investing in our people and our planet. Our team spans business, product, operations, data, and software engineering disciplines working together to manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products.
   

  

 You'll partner across teams to help customers discover great deals on quality used and open box items, improve the returns experience, and reduce waste in reverse logistics. As part of this mission\-driven team, you'll be a builder and an owner, collaborating cross\-functionally to design scalable solutions. At Amazon, Earth is our customer too—join us and help innovate for a more sustainable future.

**The Team**
 Through continued growth comes more demand for business insights and data used to make objective decisions. To support this need and help maintain operational efficiency, A\&M has invested in growing its Business Intelligence Unit (BIU). The BIU creates and maintains scalable data pipelines, constructs analysis, delivers process improvement initiatives and builds visualization tools and applications. The unit is also focused on embedding AI into its own ways of working to drive efficiency, and on enabling the business to apply AI to the data assets the team provides. The Insight Optimisation team is responsible for the ongoing health, evolution, and optimization of the firm's core reporting products. The team manages report consistency, user experience, backend data model improvements, documentation, troubleshooting, and enhancement requests. The team mission is to provide a seamless user experience to the business whilst reducing long\-term operational overhead through prioritising consistency, consolidation, and a focus on action\-driven insights.

 The Business Intelligence Unit is seeking a motivated Associate to join the Insight Optimisation team based in India. Reporting to the Manager of Insight Optimisation, the Associate will play a hands\-on role in maintaining and improving the firm's existing core reporting suite, supporting business users, and contributing to the transition to a new Snowflake data environment.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused role for someone with strong technical foundations in Power BI and SQL, a curiosity for how data is used across a business, and the discipline to work through complex troubleshooting scenarios. The successful candidate will spend their time building improvements to existing reports, investigating data issues, maintaining documentation, and working directly with business users to understand and deliver on their needs. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, comfortable working across the analytics stack, curious about how AI can enhance their work, and eager to develop their skills in a global, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

* Review report usage statistics and user feedback to identify opportunities to improve formatting, usability, and consistency across the reporting suite.

* Apply AI and generative AI tools to accelerate day\-to\-day delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Communicate clearly with business users on the status of their requests, expected timelines, and any technical constraints.

**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a data\-focused role.
* Strong report development experience, preferably Power BI, including visualisation, data modelling, and DAX.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write, read, and optimise queries against relational databases.
* Understanding of data modelling concepts and how data flows through a modern analytics stack.
* Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms is desirable; willingness to learn is essential.
* Awareness of current AI and generative AI tools, with an interest in applying them to analytics workflows and reporting products.
* Structured troubleshooting approach, with the ability to isolate problems across the analytics stack.
* Exposure to user\-centred design principles and an appreciation for the end\-user experience of analytics products.
* Familiarity with Python or another scripting language is a plus.
* Experience working in a globally distributed team or across time zones is desirable.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a relevant field, or equivalent professional work experience

title: Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**Position: Fresher QA Engineer** 




**Location: Vadodara (Onsite)** 




**Shift: UK shift (2 pm to 12 am)** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Fresher QA Engineer who is eager to learn product testing, automation testing, and release quality processes. This role is ideal for someone who has strong attention to detail, good logical thinking, and an interest in ensuring that product features work correctly before they are released to users. The Fresher QA Engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers, and product teams to validate public\-facing product features, execute test cases, identify bugs, and gradually build automation testing skills. Automation testing knowledge or willingness to learn automation is mandatory, as we want to build strong test coverage for core product flows before every release.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Understand product requirements, user flows, and expected feature behavior.
 



 • Execute test cases for new features, bug fixes, and existing product workflows.
 



 • Perform functional, smoke, sanity, regression, and exploratory testing under guidance.
 



 • Verify that public product features are working properly before release.
 



 • Identify bugs, UI issues, validation issues, broken flows, and unexpected behavior.
 



 • Report bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result, screenshots/videos, and severity.
 



 • Retest fixed issues and confirm whether bugs are resolved.
 



 • Help maintain test cases, regression checklists, and release validation documents.
 



 • Learn and support automation testing for repeated product flows.
 



 • Run existing automation scripts and help analyze basic failures.
 



 • Work closely with QA, product, and development teams to understand quality expectations.
 



 • Learn API testing basics and validate backend responses where required.
 



 • Participate in release testing and help ensure important flows are working as expected.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 • Basic understanding of software testing concepts.
 



 • Good logical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Strong attention to detail.
 



 • Ability to understand product workflows from a user perspective.
 



 • Basic knowledge of manual testing, test cases, bug reporting, and defect lifecycle.
 



 • Basic understanding of web applications, mobile applications, browsers, and responsive behavior.
 



 • Willingness to learn automation testing tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar.
 



 • Basic programming knowledge in JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python, or any similar language.
 



 • Good written communication skills for documenting bugs and test results.
 



 • Ability to follow instructions, checklists, and QA processes carefully.
 



  





**1 Automation Expectations** 




 The candidate should be willing to learn and grow in automation testing. The role will involve:
 



 • Learning how to write basic automation test scripts.
 



 • Understanding how to automate repeated regression flows.
 



 • Running existing automation test suites before release.
 



 • Understanding basic automation failures and reporting them.
 



 • Working with senior QA engineers to improve automation coverage.
 



 • Gradually contributing to smoke and regression automation.
 



  





**Product Quality Expectations** 




 The Fresher QA Engineer should learn to test features not only from a technical point of view but also from a customer point of view. This includes checking:
 



 • Whether the feature works as expected.
 



 • Whether the user flow is easy to understand.
 



 • Whether forms, buttons, links, filters, and actions work correctly.
 



 • Whether validation messages and error messages are clear.
 



 • Whether empty states, loading states, and success messages are handled properly.
 



 • Whether the feature works on important browsers and screen sizes.
 



 • Whether any existing flow is broken after a new change.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc IT, M.Sc IT, or equivalent technical background.
 



 • Internship, project, or training experience in software testing.
 



 • Basic knowledge of SQL, APIs, Postman, browser developer tools, or Git.
 



 • Exposure to automation testing tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or Appium.
 



 • Understanding of agile/scrum development process.
 



 • Any testing certification or QA training is a plus but not mandatory.
 



  





**Soft Skills** 




 • Curious and willing to learn.
 



 • Detail\-oriented and patient.
 



 • Good communication skills.
 



 • Comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear.
 



 • Strong ownership of assigned work.
 



 • Ability to work with developers, product managers, and QA team members.
 



 • Positive attitude toward feedback and improvement.
 



  





**Success Metrics** 




 Success in this role will be measured by:
 



 • Ability to understand product flows quickly.
 



 • Accuracy in executing test cases.
 



 • Quality of bug reporting.
 



 • Ability to identify basic functional and UI issues.
 



 • Timely completion of assigned QA tasks.
 



 • Improvement in automation testing skills.
 



 • Contribution to release validation and regression testing.
 



 • Consistency in following QA processes.
 



  





**Interview Focus Areas** 




 • Basic testing concepts.
 



 • Logical thinking and attention to detail.
 



 • Ability to identify test scenarios.
 



 • Bug reporting approach.
 



 • Basic understanding of web/mobile applications.
 



 • Willingness to learn automation.
 



 • Basic programming or scripting knowledge.

title: Junior Automation Testing Engineer
description:
SysCloud is a Backup\-as\-a\-Service (BaaS) platform providing the capability within a single pane of glass to backup mission critical SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, QuickBooks Online, HubSpot, Slack, and Salesforce. Our platform offers a comprehensive suite of solutions like backup, data recovery, ransomware protection, compliance alerts, and eDiscovery search. 
 



  





 SysCloud is in the midst of rapid expansion. We enable businesses of all sizes to back up, secure, and ensure compliance for their critical data in the cloud. As we continue to grow, we are looking to hire a Junior Automation Testing Engineer who will be responsible for building, executing, and maintaining automated test frameworks that ensure the quality and reliability of our platform. You will work alongside senior engineers to develop robust test suites, monitor regression pipelines, and contribute to a culture of quality across our engineering teams.
 



  





**Position: Junior Automation Testing Engineer** 




**Work Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Note: For the final round, candidates will need to visit the Hyderabad office for a face\-to\-face interview.)
 



**Experience** 
 1–2 years
 



**Educational Qualifications** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 1–2 years of experience in QA automation for web\-based applications using frameworks such as
 **Cypress or Playwright**
* **JavaScript** 
 — including async/await, ES6\+ features, and module patterns used in test scripting
* **SQL fundamentals** 
 — DDL/DML operations including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and multi\-table JOINs for data validation
* **AWS basic cloud concepts** 
 — familiarity with services like S3, Lambda, CloudWatch and ECS from a QA/infrastructure awareness perspective
* **AI/LLM tooling** 
 — understanding of AI\-assisted test generation, prompt\-based workflows, or co\-pilot tools used in modern QA pipelines



  





**No of positions 1** 




**Compensation** 
 Best as per Industry Standards.
 



**Expected** 
 Immediate
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Automation Test Script Development** 



* Cypress and Playwright frameworks for web\-based SaaS applications.
* Translate manual test cases, acceptance criteria, and user stories into reliable, maintainable automated tests.
* Write clean, modular JavaScript test code following page\-object model (POM) or component\-based patterns to maximize reusability.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and developers to identify automation opportunities and expand overall test coverage.



  





  2\.
 **Regression Framework Maintenance** 



* Own day\-to\-day health of the regression suite — monitor run stability, identify and triage flaky tests, and implement fixes promptly.
* Maintain and update existing test suites as application features evolve, ensuring tests remain accurate and aligned with current functionality.
* Contribute to framework improvements: configuration management, shared utilities, custom commands, and environment\-specific setups (local, staging, CI).
* Participate in CI/CD pipeline integration, ensuring automated tests run reliably on pull requests and scheduled regression cycles.



  





 3
 **. Bug Monitoring \& Defect Management** 



* Monitor daily test execution results, analyze failures, and distinguish genuine defects from environment or data issues.
* Log clear, reproducible bug reports in Azure DevOps with steps to reproduce, expected vs actual outcomes, logs, and screenshots.
* Track defect lifecycle from discovery through verification, collaborating with developers to confirm fixes and re\-run validation tests.
* Produce concise daily/weekly status summaries for team leads covering pass/fail metrics, open defects, and pipeline health.



  





**4\. SQL\-Based Data Validation** 



* Write and execute SQL queries (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, JOINs) to verify backend data integrity as part of end\-to\-end test workflows.
* Validate database state pre\- and post\-test to confirm that application operations produce correct and consistent data outcomes.
* Support test data setup and teardown through SQL scripts, maintaining clean and reproducible test environments.



  





**5\. Cloud \& Infrastructure Awareness** 



* Gain familiarity with AWS services (CloudWatch, S3, ECS/Lambda) to interpret log outputs and assist in root cause analysis of test failures.
* Support infrastructure\-level test scenarios such as multi\-region behavior, environment parity checks, and service\-level health validations.



  





**6\. AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering** 



* Leverage AI/LLM\-based tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate test script generation, refactoring, and documentation.
* Explore prompt engineering techniques to generate test scenarios, edge cases, and mock data with AI assistance.
* Stay current with AI developments relevant to QA — including AI\-driven test generation, intelligent test selection, and anomaly detection.



  





**7\. Collaboration \& Continuous Learning** 



* Work closely with QA leads, developers, and product engineers in sprint ceremonies — contributing to test planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Author and update test documentation, test plans, and runbooks to maintain clarity across the team.
* Proactively develop skills in test automation, cloud platforms, and modern QA practices through self\-learning and peer mentorship.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* We are looking for a Junior QA Automation Engineer to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will work on automation testing for web\-based SaaS applications using Cypress and Playwright, while gaining hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, cloud technologies, AI\-assisted testing, and modern QA practices under the guidance of senior engineers

title: Production & QA Assistant
description:
**We invite you to come grow with us.**
 Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.
   

  

**About The India Design Studio**
 We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business\-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation \& Growth.
   

  

 The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high\-value business development and client\-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.
   

  

 Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.
   

  

**How Quality Works In The Studio**
 Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self\-check before handover. The Production \& QA Assistant provides independent, checklist\-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign\-off for priority or high\-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.
   

  

**How We Use AI**
 Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.
   

  

**Your Primary Role**
**Role: Production \& QA Assistant \- India Design Studio**
 Team: India Design Studio
   

  

 The Production \& QA Assistant is a foundational role in the Design Studio, combining junior production support, independent checklist\-based QA and workflow administration. You will help protect design time, strengthen delivery discipline and ensure that files are accurate, organised and ready for client or business use.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Apply approved templates and complete basic formatting or production updates to slides, documents and supporting materials.
* Perform independent QA after the designer has completed their self\-check, reviewing formatting, alignment, pagination, footnotes, spelling, grammar, consistency, brand application, accessibility and template compliance.
* Record QA findings clearly and return issues to the designer or Senior Designer for correction; the role supports quality control but does not replace designer or business\-owner accountability.
* Check briefs and source files for completeness and flag gaps before work begins.
* Log requests, update workflow trackers and maintain an accurate record of status, turnaround, rework, feedback and common quality issues.
* Manage file naming, folder structure, version control, handover notes and final delivery packages.
* Prepare editable source files, PDFs, linked assets and usage notes for final delivery where required.
* Tag reusable assets and maintain library metadata so approved content can be found, adapted and reused.
* Use approved AI\-enabled tools responsibly to support grammar, consistency, brief summarisation, tagging or QA, with careful human review before findings are acted on.
* Escalate missing information, conflicting versions, confidentiality concerns, delivery blockers or high\-risk quality issues to the Senior Designer or relevant workflow lead.


**About You**
**Your skills and experience**
* At least 1 year of experience in production support, presentation support, document QA, creative operations, project administration or another detail\-focused role; strong entry\-level candidates with relevant internships or portfolios may also be considered.
* Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint, Word, Excel, PDF workflows and Microsoft Teams/SharePoint or similar collaboration environments.
* Excellent attention to detail and confidence checking layout, formatting, spelling, grammar, page flow, naming conventions and version control.
* Basic understanding of brand guidelines, templates, accessibility and what makes a file ready for client\-facing use.
* Experience using trackers, logs, checklists, file structures or workflow documentation accurately and consistently.
* Clear communication skills and the confidence to flag gaps, errors or risks without taking ownership away from the person responsible for correcting them.
* Practical AI literacy and a responsible approach to confidential information and human review.
* Interest in presentation production, design craft, workflow improvement and healthcare or life\-sciences client work.


 Ideal profile
   

  

* You are highly accurate, organised and calm under time pressure.
* You enjoy making files cleaner, clearer and easier for others to use.
* You take pride in catching issues and communicating them constructively before materials are delivered.
* You are motivated to develop your production, quality or design skills as the studio grows.


**Career progression**
 This role is the foundation of the Design Studio career framework. With demonstrated design craft and a suitable portfolio, progression may lead to Designer and Senior Designer. Colleagues who build deeper expertise in workflow, quality, asset management and reporting may also develop toward a Studio Operations or QA specialist pathway. Progression is based on capability, impact and available business opportunities.
   

  

**Life at Inizio Ignite**
 You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.
   

  

 In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.
   

  

**We provide**
* A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
* International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
* A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
* A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.


**Further information**
 This is a full\-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK\- and US\-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.
   

  

*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: GMS-Staff-CyberArk
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Staff**
 CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. This includes managing the CyberArk infrastructure, monitoring system performance, and providing first\-level support to resolve issues related to privileged account management. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of cybersecurity principles and be eager to learn and grow within the field.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Assist in the administration and maintenance of the CyberArk PAM solution, including the management of safes, platforms, and policies.
* Monitor the health and performance of the CyberArk environment, responding to alerts and notifications in a timely manner.
* Provide first\-level support for issues related to privileged account access, including password checkouts, session management, and account onboarding.
* Participate in the onboarding of new accounts into the CyberArk platform, ensuring compliance with security policies and best practices.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity team to implement enhancements and updates to the CyberArk infrastructure.
* Document standard operating procedures, system configurations, and incident reports.
* Assist in the development and delivery of CyberArk user training and awareness programs.
* Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and evidence related to CyberArk operations.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest CyberArk features, updates, and industry best practices.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks such as patching, upgrades, and backups of the CyberArk environment


**Preferred Skills:**
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices.
* Familiarity with Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.
* Any experience with CyberArk or other PAM solutions is beneficial but not required.
* Certifications such as CyberArk Defender or Sentry are desirable but not mandatory for entry\-level applicants


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Security & Compliance Analyst: Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Operations Mandate – from an overall ITS perspective, leveraging USI resources is strategically aligning with the Firm’s Alternative Delivery Services model. Along with other professional lines of businesses such as Tax, Advisory, Consulting and Enabling Areas like Marketplace and Business Operations, ITS is building its services and capabilities in USI to conduct operational tasks and responsibilities that allow Canadian onshore teams to focus more on ITS and business priorities. In addition, ITS continues to grow and strengthen its Support Services presence in Hyderabad to provide quality client\-facing support for our USI Canada Professionals.
   

  

 The Infra Operations function of USI DT CA Technology and Infrastructure group is accountable for Infrastructure Compliance and Vulnerability management for applications, servers, frontends etc. working closely with Server owner teams for DTC and HIMS.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Security and Compliance analyst on the Compliance Management Team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Maintaining infrastructure security, compliance, and resilience across IT, data center, cloud, and server environments.
* Managing vulnerability remediation activities, including identification, prioritization, tracking, validation rescans, and escalation of overdue or high\-risk findings.
* Administering and monitoring security, compliance, and management tools such as Splunk, Qualys, Defender, SCCM, BigFix, CMDB, backup platforms, and related server agents.
* Performing patching, upgrades, configuration changes, security\-agent deployments, and post\-change validation for supported application servers.
* Producing operational reports and KPIs covering vulnerability remediation, patch compliance, agent health, technology lifecycle, software compliance, CMDB accuracy, and remediation trends.


**The team**
 At Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000\-strong internal services team. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client\-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all of their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas; Human Resources, Clients \& Industries, Finance \& Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality \& Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services \& Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or as needed**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree
* 1\-2\.5\+ years of experience in server hardening, vulnerability management, server compliance management, data analytics, or information security
* Experience with Windows and Linux security compliance
* Experience with vulnerability management, patching, and remediation support for servers or business applications
* Experience using tools such as Qualys, SCCM, BigFix, Splunk, Defender, or similar infrastructure compliance tools
* Experience supporting CMDB, asset management, or automated discovery processes


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience supporting application vulnerability remediation for .NET, Oracle, or Java environments
* Experience with ServiceNow CMDB MID Server administration, discovery, or integrations
* Experience with Azure, Hyper\-V, Active Directory, or Linux platform support
* Experience creating infrastructure reports, dashboards, or KPI tracking in Power BI or Microsoft Excel
* Experience validating remediation fixes with stakeholders or application owners


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Team Member - Data Privacy
description:
Role summary\- You will support the execution of the organization’s Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program by conducting privacy due diligence assessments of vendors, identifying data privacy risks, ensuring compliance with applicable privacy laws and internal policies, and maintaining assessment documentation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \-
   

  

* Conduct privacy risk assessments for third\-party vendors during onboarding and periodic reviews.
* Review vendor responses to privacy questionnaires and supporting evidences.
* Assess vendors processing personal data against applicable privacy regulations (e.g., India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, General Data Protection Regulation where applicable).
* Identify privacy risks, document observations, and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Track remediation actions and follow up with internal stakeholders and vendors until closure.
* Maintain records of completed assessments, risk ratings, and supporting evidence.
* Assist in developing and updating privacy assessment questionnaires, templates, and SOPs.
* Support in audits and regulatory inspections by providing required privacy assessment documentation.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports and dashboards on TPRM assessment status and key metrics.


 Required skill \-
   

  

* Basic understanding of data privacy principles and regulations.
* Knowledge of vendor risk assessment or Third\-Party Risk Management concepts.
* Good analytical and documentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.


 Experience: 3\-4 year (Freshers with relevant certifications and data privacy internship experience may also apply)
   

  

 Education: Bachelor’s degree in law, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field.

title: Junior Analyst – Investigations & Insider Threat
description:
* LOCATION :Hyderabad, India
* DATE : 08 Sept, 2026
* JOB TYPE :FULL TIME


**About The Role**
 MitKat Advisory is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Analyst willing to work night shifts to monitor global security events and intelligence, assess potential threats to the client’s people, facilities, products, and operations, and provide timely updates and escalations. The role will support the client’s GSOC operations, incident response, crisis management, reporting, investigations, and coordination with internal stakeholders and regional security teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist the head of global investigations and training with internal investigations relating to fraud, misconduct, policy breaches, bribery and corruption and insider threat matters.
* Collect, collate, and analyse data from multiple internal sources to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies relevant to all investigations.
* Triage and escalation of alerts generated by technology\-driven monitoring systems in relation to fraud and insider risk.
* Prepare clear, accurate, and concise investigative reports, summaries, and briefing documents.
* Support the maintenance and development of the Insider Threat Program, including contributing to risk assessments and process improvements.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, HR/Employee Relations, Integrity Office, and other security functions to support investigations and share relevant intelligence.
* Conduct open\-source intelligence (OSINT) research and background checks as required to support investigative activities.
* Assist with the preparation and delivery of fraud and insider threat awareness training and communications across the organisation.
* Maintain current awareness of emerging fraud and insider threat trends, evolving methodologies, and industry best practices within the financial services sector.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date case management records in accordance with established procedures and governance requirements.
* Provide support for ad hoc projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by senior members of the Investigations \& Insider Threat team.


 Position Requirements
   

  

* Relevant tertiary qualification in investigations, open\-source intelligence, security studies, or a related discipline.
* 2–4 years’ experience in investigations, intelligence, risk, compliance, Security Operations Centre or a related field, preferably within financial services, law enforcement, or the public/private security sector.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesise information from multiple sources.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear and concise reports.
* Strong understanding of the intersection between geopolitics, economics, public policy, and business strategy.
* Familiarity with data analytics and visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, i2 Analyst Notebook, Splunk) and with a Security Information and Event Management platform.
* Understanding of, or interest in, fraud, insider threat, cyber security, or corporate security matters.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* High degree of discretion, integrity, and professionalism, particularly when handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build productive working relationships across teams and at all levels.
* A proactive, inquisitive mindset with a genuine interest in investigations and insider threat.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under pressure and to deadlines.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a small, specialist team.
* Sound judgement and decision\-making skills.

title: GRC Engineer I
description:
**About Workstreet**
 At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting\-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast\-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of frameworks—including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800\-171, NIST 800\-53, and FedRAMP—empowering companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.
   

  

****The Opportunity****
 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented GRC Engineer I to join our fast\-growing team. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in cybersecurity compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.
   

  

 This role requires strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple cybersecurity compliance projects simultaneously. The successful candidate will also have experience overseeing or managing a small team, while ensuring client engagements are delivered effectively and aligned with Workstreet’s security objectives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Support Compliance Initiatives: Assist in implementing and maintaining cybersecurity compliance programs aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other regulatory standards.
* Maintain Documentation: Develop and update cybersecurity policies, procedures, and control evidence to support audits and assessments.
* Assist in Risk Mitigation: Work with internal and external teams to identify, track, and help remediate cybersecurity risks and control gaps.
* Coordinate Project Tasks: Support multiple compliance projects by managing documentation, timelines, and deliverables under senior guidance.
* Communicate with Clients: Engage with clients via email, chat, and calls to gather evidence, clarify compliance requirements, and provide timely updates.
* Perform Control Testing: Conduct basic control checks and assist in readiness reviews to ensure continuous compliance with internal and external standards.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Partner with IT, security, and operations teams to implement corrective actions and strengthen compliance posture.
* Learn and Grow: Receive mentorship from senior team members and contribute to improving processes, templates, and playbooks for compliance delivery.


**Who You Are**
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple cybersecurity compliance projects concurrently
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills
* Proven ability to work directly with clients in the US
* Experience working in cybersecurity compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF frameworks
* Familiarity with creating and enforcing cybersecurity policies
* Experience working in a tech company with a focus on cybersecurity
* Thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment


****Nice to Have****
* Familiarity with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
* Additional experience with frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS
* Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CISA, or Security\+


**What We Offer**
* Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities
* Technical Training: Comprehensive onboarding on security and compliance frameworks
* Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit\-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
* Growth Opportunity: Early\-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
* Remote\-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.


**Work Environment Requirements**
* Reliable high\-speed internet connection.
* Quiet, professional home office setup.
* Must be amenable to work US Eastern Time zone hours.
* Fluency in written and verbal English communication skills.


****Workstreet Is An Equal Opportunity Employer****
 As an equal opportunity employer, Workstreet is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Workstreet will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
   

  

 Employment with Workstreet is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of employment history, education, and other relevant information, in compliance with applicable laws.

description:
**Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**
  

  

  

 Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage \- the combination of our next\-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease \- no matter where they are in the world.
   

  





 What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
   

  





**Who we are:**

**CMS\-TDR – Staff (WAF/SWG/MSEG\- Akamai Kona/Netskope/Illumio)**
**Job Summary**
 Looking for a security engineer with max 3 years of hands on experience in Web Application Firewall (WAF), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Micro Segmentation to secure applications, control internet access, and reduce lateral movement risk across enterprise environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and tune Akamai Kona WAF to protect web applications from OWASP Top 10 threats
* Configure and operate Netskope SWG policies for secure internet access and threat protection
* Design and enforce Illumio micro segmentation policies to control east west traffic
* Work with SOC, network, cloud, and application teams to support incidents and policy changes
* Analyze logs, reduce false positives, and maintain operational documentation
* Support audits, compliance needs, and continuous security improvements


**Required Skills**
* Hands on experience with Akamai Kona, Netskope, and Illumio
* Strong understanding of web security, HTTP/S, OWASP Top 10
* Knowledge of proxy/SWG concepts and Zero Trust / segmentation principles
* Good networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls)


**Preferred Skills**
* Cloud exposure (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* API security and bot protection exposure
* Scripting (Python / PowerShell)
* Security certifications – nice to have


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Security Engineer
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Join our company as Security Engineer (all genders) and become part of an agile team designing, building, and improving security features across the TeamViewer product line and its supporting infrastructure.
   

  

**These Will Be Some Of Your Responsibilities**
* Design and implement security controls and mechanisms directly in our products, with a strong focus on secure\-by\-design principles.
* Identify, analyze, and mitigate vulnerabilities through threat modeling, security reviews, and hands\-on testing (including aspects of offensive security).
* Collaborate closely with development teams to integrate security into the SDLC, from design to deployment, and improve existing security architectures.
* Drive the implementation of technical solutions to detect and prevent abuse scenarios in TeamViewer products.
* Contribute to security\-related automation, tooling, and processes to scale security across engineering teams.
* Act as a security consultant for product and engineering teams, helping them make risk\-informed design and implementation decisions aligned with the overall security strategy.
* Participate in applied AI security initiatives, focusing on securing AI\-driven features and leveraging AI to improve security capabilities.
* Prepare and deliver secure coding trainings, workshops, and guidance to development teams.


**Requirements**
* Degree in computer science or security or equivalent working experience
* Ideally 5\+ years professional experience in a similar position, specifically focused on security issues
* Strong interest and understanding of security aspects of AI usage in Software Development process
* Knowledge of C\+\+ and at least a basic understanding of other programming languages such as Java, C\# or Go
* Good foundation in web architectures as well as scalable distributed systems
* Experience in implementing encryption, cryptography, software security and authentication, both in the field of software development and the design of network protocols.
* Passion about finding secure, innovative and user\-friendly solutions for highly complex problems
* Experience in mentoring, consulting and guiding other developers and teams of developers in building secure solutions
* Experience and interest in working in distributed teams
* Fluency in English is mandatory, further languages such as German are a plus


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.
   

  

 If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

title: Specialist , OT Security Engineering
description:
****Job Description****
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

****Role Overview****
 The OT Security Engineer (Level 2\) designs and delivers project\-driven OT cybersecurity solutions that keep pharmaceutical manufacturing secure, reliable, and compliant. You’ll partner with site engineering/automation, operations, network services, and enterprise security to deploy scalable security patterns globally—balancing safety, GxP/GMP quality, availability, and risk reduction—and designing for both existing legacy infrastructure and greenfield deployments.
   

  

 The role focuses on security\-by\-design for OT Purdue\-aligned segmentation, secure remote access, visibility/monitoring, and OT vulnerability management, delivered through repeatable reference architectures, standards, and implementation playbooks across multiple sites
   

  

****What Will You Do In This Role****
* Provide IT and OT security expertise, with a focus on building and sustaining a secure manufacturing and laboratory environment.
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and IT Risk Management/Security to identify and assess cyber risks to OT systems, and design and implement effective mitigation strategies.
* Review and provide input shop\-floor and lab\-floor firewall rules, balancing usability, operational requirements, and security.
* Create, review, and approve IT infrastructure designs supporting new OT projects, ensuring alignment with OT security standards and architectural principles.
* Educate technical teams on OT complexities, ensuring they understand how OT differs from traditional IT and can address the unique constraints and requirements of OT environments.
* Prepare and deliver project briefings, communicating complex technical topics clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


****Core Technical Skills****
* Strong understanding of OT network architecture and segmentation (e.g., Purdue Model, iDMZ, Zones and Conduits)
* Hands\-on experience with network security controls (firewalls, IDS/IPS, access control, secure protocols)
* Knowledge of IT/OT convergence risks and secure data flow design across trust zones
* Familiarity with remote access security solutions (e.g., Zero Trust, privileged access, secure vendor)
* Solid understanding of OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST SP 800\-82, ISA/IEC 62443\)
* Knowledge of secure network design, segmentation, and change control processes for critical infrastructure


****Soft Skills****
* Strong communication and collaboration
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking


****What Should You Have****
* Minimum Education Requirement Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Global collaboration This role will work closely with colleagues across the U.S. East Coast, Dublin (Ireland), Prague (Czech Republic), and Singapore technology centers.
* Experience 3\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* OT/IT security background Experience designing and operating IT/OT cybersecurity controls for critical infrastructure systems.
* Firewall governance Experience reviewing and approving firewall rules, with a strong understanding of the security risks associated with data flows across segmented network zones.
* Shop floor / lab systems design review Experience reviewing real\-time shop floor and laboratory system designs to ensure data flows meet appropriate security and resiliency requirements.
* Experience designing or supporting IT and OT systems for manufacturing and laboratory environments in the following domains Firewalls, Remote Access Management, Network security design \& observability
* Execution mindset Results\-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to develop plans and execute them successfully.


****Preferred Skills****
* Broad understanding of IT and OT systems supporting Manufacturing \& Supply Chain operations, including MES, quality and laboratory systems, resource planning systems, process control technologies, and cold chain / other supply chain systems.
* Intermediate understanding of industrial/OT security concepts and familiarity with relevant industry standards and guidance, such as NIST SP 800\-53, NIST SP 800\-82, and related NIST publications.
* Working knowledge and practical application of the Purdue Model for network segmentation in industrial environments.
* Prior experience in the pharmaceutical industry is preferred.


 Entry\-level cybersecurity certification (e.g., CEH, CompTIA, GISF, GSEC, or similar).
   

  

****Who We Are****
 We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

****What We Look For****
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

description:
**About Flam :** 




  





 Flam is an AI\-native content platform building the future of interactive experiences. Our proprietary AI models power four product lines — Flam Instant App (mixed reality advertising), Flam AI Visual Agent (real\-time avatar interactions), Flam Native Ads, and Flowy.ai (AI creative canvas) — serving Fortune 500 brands across the US and India.
 



  





**The Opportunity :** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on IT Admin \& Security Engineer who is equally comfortable setting up a newemployee's MacBook as they are configuring GCP firewall rules. This is a dual\-hat role: you will own the day\-to\-day IT operations for 100\+ employees across two offices — device management, SaaS tool administration,onboarding and offboarding — while simultaneously implementing the technical security controls required for our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification. You will work closely with the GRC Lead and report to the CISO.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Device \& Endpoint Management (Primary) :** 



* Own the full device lifecycle for all 100\+ employees — procurement, configuration, deployment, andsecure disposal of MacBooks and any other endpoints
* Deploy, configure, and maintain an MDM solution (Jamf, Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent) across all employee devices
* Enforce security policies via MDM: full\-disk encryption, screen lock, automatic OS updates, antivirus/EDR installation, and remote wipe capability
* Maintain a real\-time device inventory in Scrut's Asset Management module — every device tagged with owner, classification, and compliance status
* Conduct and document quarterly MDM compliance audits showing 100% policy enforcement across all devices



**Onboarding \& Offboarding :** 



* Own the technical onboarding checklist — new joiner gets their device configured, all SaaS accounts provisioned, and MFA enrolled before Day 1
* Own offboarding — access revocation across all systems within 24 hours of departure, device retrieval,and remote wipe if required
* Maintain joiners/leavers/movers log as evidence for ISO 27001 A.5\.18 and SOC 2 access control criteria
* Work with HR to ensure zero orphaned accounts — monthly reconciliation of IDP user list against HR active employee records



**Identity \& Access Management :** 



* Administer the Identity Provider (Google Workspace, Okta, or equivalent) — user provisioning, group management, SSO configuration for all SaaS tools
* Enforce MFA across all accounts — export and maintain 100% MFA enrollment report as ongoing audit evidence in Scrut
* Conduct quarterly access reviews across all systems — coordinate with department heads to confirm access is still required for each user
* Manage service account inventory in GCP — ensure all service accounts have named human owners and minimum necessary permissions



**SaaS Tool Administration:** 



* Administer and secure all company SaaS tools — Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Jira, Scrut,and others
* Maintain an approved SaaS tool register — track what tools are in use, who owns them, what data they hold, and their security configuration
* Enforce SSO and MFA on every SaaS tool where the platform supports it
* Identify and remove shadow IT — tools being used by teams without IT awareness or approval



**GCP \& Cloud Security :** 



* Work alongside DevOps to implement and maintain GCP security configurations: VPC firewall rules, IAM policies, org\-level security policies, and Cloud Audit Logs
* Connect GCP and Modal.com to Scrut's Cloud module and maintain automated security posture scanning — track and remediate misconfigurations
* Ensure encryption at rest is enabled on all GCS buckets containing customer data and model weights
* Maintain centralised logging in GCP Cloud Logging — confirm audit logs are enabled across all projects, retained for 12 months, and tamper\-protected
* Run regular vulnerability scans using GCP Security Command Center or equivalent — document findings and track remediation to closure



**Network \& Office Security :** 



* Manage office network security at both the HSR Layout (Bengaluru) office — VLAN segmentation, guest Wi\-Fi isolation, DNS filtering
* Deploy and maintain VPN for remote access to internal systems and production infrastructure
* Configure and maintain web filtering (Cloudflare Gateway or equivalent) covering both office and remote workers
* Maintain network diagrams and data flow diagrams as required by Scrut control AST\-04



**Security Controls \& Audit Evidence :** 



* Own all technical controls in Scrut across the Endpoint Security, Identification \& Authentication, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Asset Management domains — 60\+ controls directly under your remit
* Collect, upload, and maintain evidence in Scrut for every assigned control — screenshots, exports, scan reports, configuration files
* Respond to evidence requests from the GRC Lead and external auditors during ISO 27001 Stage 1/Stage 2 audits and SOC 2 assessment
* Implement and test the remote wipe procedure for lost or stolen devices — document test results as audit evidence



  





**What We're Looking For :** 



* 3–4 years of experience in an IT admin, IT operations, or junior security engineer role
* Hands\-on experience with at least one MDM platform — Jamf, Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or equivalent
* Experience administering Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 at an organisational level — user management, group policies, security settings
* Familiarity with GCP or AWS — comfortable navigating IAM, VPC, storage, and audit log configurations
* Experience with identity providers and SSO — Okta, Google Workspace, Azure AD
* Understanding of endpoint security fundamentals — disk encryption, EDR, antivirus, patch management
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup where you will own problems end\-to\-end without a large team behind you



  





**Nice to Have :** 



* Experience supporting a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit — collecting evidence, responding to auditor requests
* Familiarity with a GRC platform (Scrut.io, Vanta, Drata, or equivalent)
* Google Workspace Administrator certification or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer certification
* Experience with CI/CD security tooling — GitHub Actions security, container image scanning, SAST integration
* Knowledge of network security fundamentals — VLANs, firewall rules, DNS filtering, VPN
* Scripting ability (Python or Bash) for automating IT operations tasks — account provisioning, compliance reporting
* Prior experience at a startup or high\-growth tech company

title: Software Engineer I - Salesforce Support
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Tier 1 Support Specialist \- Salesforce Platform Operations
   

  

**Job Level**
 SWE1 (Entry to Junior Level)
   

  

**Department**
 Product \& Engineering / Technology Delivery
   

  

**Role Type**
 Full\-time
   

  

 The Tier 1 Support Specialist serves as the primary point of contact for daily business operations, specifically focusing on Salesforce Platform Operations support. This role is responsible for managing day\-to\-day support tickets, monitoring platform performance, troubleshooting Salesforce user issues, performing routine data maintenance / bulk data loads and providing light QA assistance. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, you will help resolve production issues, document support processes, and ensure that operational workflows run smoothly and meet quality standards.
   

  

**Job Description \& Key Responsibilities**
**Tier 1 Support \& Issue Resolution**
* Monitor Salesforce platform performance and errors, create necessary bug tickets or perform other necessary actions as instructed depending on the severity of the issue
* Manage and resolve day\-to\-day Salesforce support tickets, ensuring timely responses and high\-quality resolution for business users.
* Perform basic Salesforce troubleshooting and diagnostic tasks to identify and resolve user\-reported system issues.
* Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or developers while maintaining clear communication with the affected business stakeholders.
* Perform regular data load operations (import, update, export, upsert) using data management tools while maintaining data integrity and accuracy.


**Salesforce \& Business Analysis**
* Provide daily operational support for the Salesforce platform, including user permissions, basic configuration updates, and data integrity checks.
* Perform regular data maintenance and cleanup activities to ensure Salesforce records remain accurate and actionable for the business.
* Assist the QA team with light testing tasks, such as smoke testing and regression testing of support\-related fixes and enhancements.
* Participate in story refinement and requirement gathering sessions to ensure clear project scope and execution.


**Automation \& Process Improvement**
* Create and maintain process documentation for common support issues and resolution workflows to improve team efficiency.
* Support basic QA testing efforts for new features or bug fixes to ensure operational stability before deployment.
* Identify, track, and communicate testing risks, dependencies, and defects to team leads and project managers.
* Continuously build technical skills, domain knowledge, and testing capabilities to support increasingly complex systems.


**Experience**
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 0–2 years of experience in Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Quality Assurance, or a related technology role.
* Salesforce \& Data Management:
* Basic experience with Salesforce platform configuration and familiarity with data loading tools (e.g., Salesforce Data Loader, Workbench, or Import Wizard).
* Technical Aptitude:
* Understanding of software delivery lifecycles, basic API testing concepts (e.g., Postman), database fundamentals, and data integrity verification.
* Problem\-Solving:
* Analytical mindset with a passion for troubleshooting production issues and performing root\-cause analysis.
* Communication \& Collaboration:
* Strong communication skills with an eagerness to learn from senior engineers and partner effectively across business and technical teams.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s of Science in Computer Science/Electronics or similar engineering/technical disciplines from a government approved university.
   

  

**About Us**
 ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go\-To\-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI\-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller.
   

  

 ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice for more details on how we handle your personal information.
   

  

 ZoomInfo may use a software\-based assessment as part of the recruitment process. More information about this tool, including the results of the most recent bias audit, is available here.
   

  

 ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements.

An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Staff**
 CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. This includes managing the CyberArk infrastructure, monitoring system performance, and providing first\-level support to resolve issues related to privileged account management. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of cybersecurity principles and be eager to learn and grow within the field.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Assist in the administration and maintenance of the CyberArk PAM solution, including the management of safes, platforms, and policies.
* Monitor the health and performance of the CyberArk environment, responding to alerts and notifications in a timely manner.
* Provide first\-level support for issues related to privileged account access, including password checkouts, session management, and account onboarding.
* Participate in the onboarding of new accounts into the CyberArk platform, ensuring compliance with security policies and best practices.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity team to implement enhancements and updates to the CyberArk infrastructure.
* Document standard operating procedures, system configurations, and incident reports.
* Assist in the development and delivery of CyberArk user training and awareness programs.
* Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and evidence related to CyberArk operations.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest CyberArk features, updates, and industry best practices.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks such as patching, upgrades, and backups of the CyberArk environment


**Preferred Skills:**
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices.
* Familiarity with Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.
* Any experience with CyberArk or other PAM solutions is beneficial but not required.
* Certifications such as CyberArk Defender or Sentry are desirable but not mandatory for entry\-level applicants


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:
\# IT Support Specialist (MSP) — Australian Shift
 



  





 \*
 **\*Location:** 
 \*\* Mohali, Punjab — 100% onsite, work from office (no remote or hybrid)
 



 \*
 **\*Shift:** 
 \*\* 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday (Australian business hours)
 



 \*
 **\*Salary:** 
 \*\* ₹6,00,000 – ₹10,00,000 per annum, based on experience
 



 \*
 **\*Employment type:** 
 \*\* Full\-time, permanent
 



  





  





 \#\# About the role
 



  





 We are an Australian\-owned IT support and managed services provider looking after
 



 home users and small businesses across Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, Perth and
 



 Adelaide. Our Mohali office is the front line of that operation.
 



  





 You will be the first voice an Australian customer hears when their email stops
 



 working, their internet drops out, or their PC won't start. You'll take the call,
 



 work out what's actually wrong, fix what can be fixed remotely, and book a
 



 technician onsite when it can't. Roughly half your day is phone and booking work,
 



 the other half is hands\-on remote support.
 



  





 This is a real technical role, not a script\-reading job. If you enjoy solving a
 



 different problem every hour and talking to customers while you do it, you'll do
 



 well here.
 



  





 \#\# What you'll do
 



  





 • Answer inbound customer calls, diagnose the issue over the phone, and set the
 



 right expectation on cost and turnaround
 



 • Book onsite visits into technician calendars and schedule remote support sessions
 



 • Deliver remote support to residential and business customers using remote access tools
 



 • Set up and troubleshoot email — IMAP, POP3, Microsoft Exchange and Microsoft 365,
 



 across Outlook, Apple Mail, iPhone and Android
 



 • Set up printers and scanners — drivers, network and wireless printing, shared
 



 printers, scan\-to\-email
 



 • Set up and troubleshoot internet connections — modems, routers, Wi\-Fi coverage,
 



 NBN and mobile broadband faults, and knowing when to escalate to the ISP
 



 • Handle Windows administration — Windows 10/11, user accounts and profiles, Windows
 



 Server and Active Directory basics, updates, backups, malware cleanup
 



 • Support Apple devices — macOS, Apple ID and iCloud, Time Machine, Mail setup, iPhone
 



 and iPad configuration
 



 • Log every job accurately in our ticketing system with clear, complete notes
 



 • Follow up with customers until the issue is genuinely resolved
 



  





 \#\# What you need
 



  





 • 2\+ years in an MSP, IT helpdesk or managed services environment (MSP experience is
 



 essential — you should already understand tickets, SLAs and multi\-client support)
 



 • Strong hands\-on skills across email configuration, printers, internet and networking,
 



 Windows administration and Apple support
 



 • Practical networking knowledge — DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, port forwarding, Wi\-Fi
 



 troubleshooting, basic switch and firewall concepts
 



 • Excellent spoken and written English, and the confidence to explain technical things
 



 simply to a non\-technical customer
 



 • Genuine willingness to work the 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM IST shift long term, from our
 



 Mohali office
 



 • Patience and a calm phone manner — many customers call when they are already frustrated
 



  





 \#\# Nice to have
 



  





 • Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration
 



 • Experience with RMM and PSA tools
 



 • Intune, MDM or Apple Business Manager exposure
 



 • CompTIA A\+ / Network\+, or Microsoft certifications
 



 • Prior experience supporting Australian, UK or US customers
 



  





 \#\# What success looks like in the first 30 days
 



  





 • Handling inbound calls independently and booking jobs without supervision
 



 • Resolving common email, printer and internet issues remotely on the first call
 



 • Writing ticket notes clear enough that any technician can pick up the job cold
 



 • Customers asking for you by name
 



  





 \#\# Why join us
 



  





 • Direct exposure to a growing Australian MSP, not a large anonymous call floor
 



 • Broad technical variety — home users one hour, business networks the next
 



 • Training and certification support
 



 • Your afternoons and evenings are your own
 



  





 \*Please only apply if you are based in or willing to relocate to Mohali and are
 



 comfortable with the 3:00 AM start.\*
