The Company operates 71 manufacturing and automation facilities across 20 countries and serves customers in over 160 countries. For more information about Lincoln Electric and its products and services, visit the Company’s website at https://www.lincolnelectric.com.
   

  

 Location:
 **Chennai**
 Req ID:
 **29977**
 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Advanced Technical Support:
+ Provide Level 1 support for desktop, laptop, server, and network devices.
+ Diagnose and resolve complex hardware and software issues.
+ Assist with the setup, configuration, and maintenance of IT equipment.
+ Respond to escalated support requests from Level 1 support.

* Incident and Problem Management:
+ Log and track incidents and service requests in the ticketing system.
+ Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues.
+ Escalate critical issues to Level 2 support or external vendors as necessary.

title: Online Systems Administrator
description:
At Rockstar Games, we create world\-class entertainment experiences.
   

  

 Become part of a team working on some of the most rewarding, large\-scale creative projects to be found in any entertainment medium \- all within an inclusive, highly motivated environment where you can learn and collaborate with some of the most talented people in the industry.
   

  

 Rockstar is on the lookout for a System Administrator who is passionate about providing 24x7 Network Operations and Support.
   

  

 This is a full\-time, in\-office position based out of Rockstar’s large game development studio in Bangalore, India.
   

  

**What We Do**
* The Rockstar Games Online System Administrator team provides 24x7 Network Operations to our online games, features, and services.
* We provide hands\-on NOC services and support to the IT Operations encompassing enterprise, Online, and development environments.
* We build, maintain and plan monitoring systems and infrastructure for upcoming releases.


**Responsibilities**
* Install, maintain, and administer Windows/Linux systems in a highly available, public\-facing environment.
* Deploy and administer SQL Server 2017/2019 in clustered/non\-clustered configurations, with patching and migrations.
* Develop standard operating procedures for high availability, perform routine maintenance, and support root cause analysis efforts.
* Run IIS/.Net C\# applications and local VMware multi\-cluster environment.
* Ensure high availability during system maintenance, patching, and hardware upgrades.
* Perform L1/L2 MS Active Directory administration and monitor services (Check MK, Splunk, Grafana).
* Provide timely and creative solutions to difficult problems.
* Work with Data Center technicians to plan hardware maintenance and resolve hardware related issues.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of demonstrable ability in a Linux and/or Windows environment using related technologies and standards such as DHCP, DNS, DFS, LDAP, IPSEC, CIFS, SMB, etc.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, along with IT certifications, or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrable experience administering systems in high\-traffic, public\-facing environments, with hands\-on experience in VMWare, IIS, SQL Server, RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Apache, Mongo, and MySQL.Good understanding of TCP/IP networks, with good communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to remain composed in fast paced situations, balancing multiple projects, and communicating efficiently.
* Proficient in scripting languages: PowerShell/DSC, Bash, Shell, Python, PHP, and/or Perl.
* Strong analytical thinking, with knowledge of complex IT systems, network topology, and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with REST API automation, and ability to work with distributed teams to develop automated workflows using PowerShell/DSC and Chef.


**PLUSES**
 Please note that these are desirable skills and are not required to apply for the position.
   

  

* MCSE/MCITP certification, or equivalent experience.
* RHEL certifications or equivalent experience.
* Experience with supporting online gaming development and production environments.
* General Cisco IOS administration experience for adding removing VLANS, setting up ACLs.
* Experience with L1/L2 MS Active Directory administration.
* Knowledge of C\#.

 Please apply with a CV and cover letter demonstrating how you meet the skills above. If we would like to move forward with your application, a Rockstar recruiter will reach out to you to explain next steps and guide you through the process.

title: IT systems administrator for Atlassian and endpoint management
description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
   

  

 As a System Administrator within .Monks, you will be responsible for the maintenance, configuration, and ongoing operation of computer systems and cloud platforms. Working as part of the SysOps IT team, your observations and input will help drive the evolution of tech administration within our company as we look to establish stronger policies, more security, better organization, and enhanced efficiency. As the IT, and especially AI, needs of the company continue to grow, you will have the opportunity to learn new technologies and propose projects. Automating IT tasks will be a focus.
   

  

 This role is well\-suited for those who are self\-sufficient, dependable, looking for new challenges, and are interested in expanding their skillset.
   

  

 This is a primarily remote role, with infrequent, pre\-arranged onsite tasks at our Noida or Gurugram offices.
   

  

**Responsibilities Will Include**
 Atlassian Platform Stewardship
   

  

  

* Operational Oversight: Serve as the primary administrator for the Atlassian Organization.
* System Hygiene \& Cleanup: Lead regular "environmental audits" to identify and archive stale projects, unused custom fields, and redundant schemes. You will ensure that Jira remains performant and easy to navigate for all users.
* Tempo Administration: Manage Tempo configurations, including worklog attributes, period locking, and team structures to ensure accurate time tracking and reporting.
* Financial Optimization: Take a lead role in Atlassian license renewals. Monitor seat utilization, identify inactive accounts, and optimize tiering to ensure we are only paying for what we use.
* Platform Awareness: Stay ahead of Atlassian’s rapid release cycle. Be the first to know about upcoming changes, assess their impact on our apps, and communicate updates to the business.


 Regional SaaS \& MDM Escalation
   

  

  

* Regional Support: Act as the primary escalation path during local office hours for tools managed by the global team (including Slack, Google Workspace, Jamf, and Intune).
* Tier 2/3 Resolution: Resolve complex technical issues that standard IT support cannot handle, ensuring seamless operation for the local team before the global admins come online.


 ISO 27001 Compliance \& Audit
   

  

  

* Audit Readiness: Help prepare the IT environment for ISO 27001 audits by maintaining strict access controls and change management records.
* Evidence Collection: Be an active participant in audit interviews, providing "point\-in\-time" evidence such as access logs, termination of access reports, and proof of system patching.


**Background Sought**
**Technical Background Sought:**
* Cloud\-Based Business Platform Administration: Google Workspace, Slack Enterprise Grid, Microsoft365/Azure and Atlassian Org Administration.
* OS: Windows server, Linux.
* Networking Hardware: Fortinet, Ubiquiti.
* Identity \& Endpoint Management: OneLogin, Jamf, Intune, and A1\.
* Bonus points for experience with automation or APIs.
* Familiarity with at least one scripting language.


**General Requirements**
* Typically 2–5\+ years in systems administration or a similar operational role.
* Experience running audits/reports and presenting findings.
* Flexibility in working hours.
* Exhibits patience and resilience under pressure.
* Detail\-oriented and strong organizational skills.
* Strong verbal \& written communication skills.
* Self\-sufficient, proactive, and ready for a challenge.
* Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking abilities.


**About Monks**
 Monks is the global, digital\-first, data\-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high\-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long\-term impact.
   

  

 Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022\-25\) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020\-24\). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023\) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting\-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025\), runner\-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024\), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.
